articles.title: AlgoPilot: Cross-Paradigm Reasoning in Language Models via Strategy Selection and Guidance
articles.abstract: Real-world problems span diverse domains, including program synthesis, symbolic reasoning, planning, and optimization, and often require fundamentally different solution paradigms. A central challenge for LLM-based reasoning is twofold: identifying an appropriate problem-solving approach and formulating it correctly. In this paper, we propose AlgoPilot, a cross-paradigm reasoning framework that enables adaptive selection of the solving approaches and structured problem formulation prior to execution. The AlgoPilot framework contains three components: 1) a SteerLM, trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), that adaptively selects the solving strategy (paradigm and modes) based on input problems, 2) the corresponding expert GuideLM, trained via SFT, that generates structured formulation guidance tailored to the selected strategy, and 3) an ExecutionLM that generates solutions conditioned on both the selected strategy and its formulation. Unlike prompting-based methods that rely on fixed reasoning templates, our approach learns to adaptively choose and structure problem-solving strategies based on the input. We build AlgoPilot on Qwen3-8B and evaluate across 5 problem categories and 13 benchmarks with 66 unique domains, comparing against both the latest similarly scaled small models and large LLMs. AlgoPilot significantly improves average accuracy for the same model from 38.4% to 72.9%, outperforming the best large LLM prompting baseline GLM-5 by 11.7%. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component. Notably, we show that the learned steering and formulation modules can transfer across execution models, suggesting their potential to improve other LLMs. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/algopilot.
articles.titleCn: AlgoPilot：通过策略选择和引导实现语言模型中的跨范式推理
articles.abstractCn: 现实世界中的问题涵盖多个领域，包括程序合成、符号推理、规划和优化，并且通常需要根本不同的解决方案范式。基于大型语言模型（LLM）的推理面临的核心挑战有两个：识别合适的解题方法以及正确地构建问题。在本文中，我们提出了AlgoPilot，一个跨范式推理框架，它能够在执行之前自适应地选择解题方法并进行结构化问题构建。AlgoPilot框架包含三个组件：1）通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）训练的SteerLM，根据输入问题自适应地选择解题策略（范式和模式）；2）相应的专家GuideLM，通过SFT训练，为选定的策略生成结构化构建指导；3）ExecutionLM，根据选定的策略及其构建生成解决方案。与依赖固定推理模板的提示方法不同，我们的方法学习根据输入自适应地选择和结构化解题策略。我们基于Qwen3-8B构建AlgoPilot，并在5个问题类别和13个基准测试（涵盖66个独特领域）中进行了评估，与最新规模相似的微型模型和大型LLM进行了比较。AlgoPilot将相同模型的平均准确率显著提高，从38.4%提升至72.9%，超过了最佳大型LLM提示基线GLM-5，领先11.7%。消融研究证实了每个组件的有效性。值得注意的是，我们展示了学习到的引导和构建模块可以在不同执行模型之间迁移，表明它们有潜力改进其他LLM。项目页面：https://sites.google.com/view/algopilot。

articles.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
articles.abstract: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.
articles.titleCn: WebHarbor：为进化式GUI代理环境对接真实网站
articles.abstractCn: 图形用户界面（GUI）网络代理需要真实且可交互的环境，这些环境在评估和训练过程中必须保持稳定。实时网站评估受限于内容变化、访问限制以及认证工作流的覆盖范围有限，而现有的训练合成环境往往缺乏功能深度和视觉保真度。我们提出了WebHarbor，这是一套包含153个可执行和容器化的网站环境，能够在确定性控制下忠实重建真实世界网络服务的视觉界面、内容和功能工作流。我们通过任务驱动的智能体-人类协作构建WebHarbor，其中环境随着新任务的加入而扩展功能范围，编码代理实现所需变更，人类贡献者审核视觉保真度、功能正确性和任务有效性。最终形成的套件包含3,518个任务，涵盖多步骤和认证后工作流，而现有工作往往未能覆盖这些任务。除了可靠的评估，WebHarbor还提供了高保真度合成网络环境，以实现成本高效的强化学习（RL）。我们证明，在WebHarbor中通过RL训练的Qwen 4B级GUI代理能够泛化到未见过的新任务，并在四个基准测试中与领先的开放源代码GUI网络代理表现出竞争力。代码和数据已公开发布在https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor。

articles.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
articles.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.
articles.titleCn: D&A：分离描述与评估使VLM成为零样本机器人奖励模型
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人学习中的零样本视频任务进度评估方面具有潜力，但现有框架常因隐式成功假设或相对时间排序设计而存在确认偏差，导致在失败执行中产生虚假进度。对前沿模型的简单提示会退化为二元成功检测器，无法捕捉细致的非线性进度和失败情况。虽然训练后方法可以通过显式训练来缓解这些问题，但它们需要昂贵的真实世界机器人数据，并对每个基础模型进行计算密集型的训练后处理。为解决这些限制，我们引入了D&A（描述与评估）：我们的方法将进度评估分解为两个阶段——首先对场景动态进行客观、基于任务的文本描述，然后使用显式标准进行评估。通过迫使VLM在评分前合成一个明确的、基于文本的成功绝对定义，该框架将评估锚定在外部、全局标准上，而不是视频的内部时间线。实证结果表明，我们的方法校准了零样本估计并减轻了确认偏差，提供了细粒度的、部分进度指标，能够准确惩罚失败的执行，同时正确插值成功的运行。作为纯提示方法，D&A能够跨任务、跨载体和跨基准泛化——性能匹配或超越训练后奖励模型——并且其奖励估计能够支持高效的下游强化学习。

articles.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
articles.abstract: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.
articles.titleCn: 策略师：通过智能体进化推理
articles.abstractCn: 一个模型只是AI智能体系统的一半，另一半是推理策略：将模型调用转化为响应的推理过程。如今，这另一半策略是手动编写的，构建一个策略的经验从未能延续到下一个策略。我们介绍了Strategist，一个元智能体，能够在不同任务中进化推理策略。每个策略都编写为蓝图，可被其他策略复用的可执行代码，这些蓝图共同构成了一个库。给定一个任务和少量开发数据集，Strategist会检索相关的蓝图，编写候选策略，在真实样本上测试它们，并根据结果进行修改。每个候选策略随后都会进入库中，以便后续任务能够基于早期的发现进行构建。在30个基准测试中，Strategist在24个测试中超越了最强的基线，并在39%更低的推理成本下达到了与基线平均准确率（74.7% vs. 74.0%）相同的水平。它的策略还可以在没有进一步搜索的情况下迁移到未见过的任务和其他模型上。AI系统中那个无法自我改进的部分，现在可以做到了。

articles.title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.
articles.titleCn: 追踪大语言模型的科学发现能力与其训练数据
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学发现方面展现出日益增长的潜力，然而关于什么能够实现可靠发现的基础性问题仍然存在。我们如何将LLMs的科学发现能力追溯到其训练数据？我们将这一问题研究为缺失概率质量的一部分，并发展了一种理论解释，其中单事实——在训练过程中只观测到一次的事实——决定了发现能力。在材料科学和监管基因组学领域，我们直接操纵训练集中的单事实率，发现更多的单事实在两个开放权重模型家族、不同的采样策略和推理预算下始终能带来更多的发现。进一步的实验表明，这种关系不能仅由训练集多样性解释，并且当与领域内数据结合时，这种关系可以跨科学领域转移。综合我们的结果，识别了训练数据中的单事实率是控制语言模型发现的关键因素。

articles.title: ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch
articles.abstract: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small on both sets with paired intervals wholly below zero; Whisper large-v3 (greedy) scores 0.0604 and 0.0767. On conversational speech the WER is 0.3807. We also report punctuation and casing, degraded audio, and how closely each shipped export reproduces the trained model.
articles.comment: 9 pages (text on pages 1 to 8, references on pages 8 and 9). Model, card, attribution, code and demo: https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak, https://kulak.ufakzeka.com
articles.titleCn: 从零开始构建和评估一个3160万参数的土耳其语音识别器
articles.abstractCn: ufakzeka-kulak是一个参数量为31.6M的开源土耳其语音转文本模型，采用FastConformer编码器，结合token和时长转换器（TDT）以及CTC输出层，从零开始训练并遵循Apache-2.0协议发布。该模型输出带大小写和标点的土耳其文本，并将数字以单词形式呈现。其4,977小时的训练数据来源于允许商业使用的授权来源；其中281小时为人工转录，其余4,696小时为上传者字幕或机器转录文本，仅保留在音频的二次独立朗读与文本一致时使用。模型配方、检查点、标注及导出选项均在开发数据上选定，测试集在训练前固定的发布门限下进行一次性评分。采用贪婪TDT解码时，在FLEURS土耳其测试集上标准化字错误率（WER）为0.0921（95%置信区间0.0792至0.1055），在Common Voice 27.0土耳其测试集上为0.0916（0.0873至0.0958），均低于Whisper基础版和Whisper小型版，且配对置信区间完全低于零；Whisper large-v3（贪婪）得分分别为0.0604和0.0767。在对话语音场景下，WER为0.3807。我们还报告了标点大小写处理、退化音频处理效果，以及各导出版本对训练模型的复现程度。

articles.title: DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control
articles.abstract: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent, a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control (APC) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim, we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.
articles.titleCn: DiabAgent：迈向自主生理控制
articles.abstractCn: 随着预训练规模的扩大，医疗语言模型在临床问答领域取得了快速进展。它们通过持续干预实现有效生理控制的能力仍缺乏系统的定量评估。1型糖尿病提供了一个具体场景：受损的胰岛素分泌导致对外源性胰岛素的依赖，剂量需根据饮食、运动、疾病和血糖测量信息持续调整。我们引入了DiabAgent，一个用于代理式生理控制的研究套件，包括代理式生理控制（APC）框架、DiabetSim模拟器和SweetBench基准。APC通过医疗设备工具控制血糖，利用持续观察来推断个体状态、积累个人经验并选择治疗行动。我们构建了DiabetSim来模拟不同患者、事件和设备条件，以进行可扩展的虚拟测试和训练。使用DiabetSim，我们将32种场景设计实例化为212个血糖控制任务，构建了SweetBench基准。Claude Opus 5.5在固定决策间隔为一小时的情况下，APC实现了73.5的COGI，而开源闭环基线OpenAPS为71.2。消融实验进一步表明，个体适应和上下文信息能改善血糖控制。结合高频规则控制与低频代理决策显示出平衡控制性能和计算成本的潜力。我们的工作为代理参与人类生理控制提供了框架、模拟器和评估基础。

articles.title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
articles.abstract: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.
articles.titleCn: Sonar-MoE：针对内存高效专家混合训练的逆向专家更新
articles.abstractCn: Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型的大多数参数属于其专家，标准训练会保持每个专家的梯度在GPU内存中直到优化器步骤。这种内存会随着专家的数量和大小增长，因此随着MoE模型的扩展而增加。我们引入了Sonar-MoE，它在反向传播过程中更新每个专家张量，并立即释放其梯度。它将优化器在反向传播从密集模型引入到批量MoE专家张量，因此GPU永远不会持有超过一层专家梯度。当我们在bf16格式下微调OLMoE-1B-7B和Granite-3.1-3B-A800M，使用两个专家-内核后端时，Sonar-MoE将峰值内存降低了19%到22%。它的更新与标准训练（无专家梯度裁剪）的位级完全相同，保留损失保持在所有基线的0.003以内。每一步也比使用全局范数裁剪的标准训练快17%到23%。更新整个批量张量而不是单个专家是Sonar-MoE保持快速的原因，因为它避免了在使用相同内存时产生20%到72%的减速。Sonar-MoE在内存和速度上与优化器在反向传播匹配所有参数，同时仍然对密集参数进行裁剪。

articles.title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
articles.abstract: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.
articles.titleCn: NitiBench+：一个涵盖17个领域的实时泰语法律问答基准
articles.abstractCn: 法律会随着时间的推移而变化。法院根据当日有效的法律审理案件，而法律问答基准则根据当前法律对答案进行评分。我们检查了泰国四个法院的156,650个判决。其中高达67%的判决引用了后来已被修改或废除的法律。我们介绍了NitiBench+，它是我们NitiBench的续作，是一个包含1,670个项目、跨越17个领域的泰国法律问答基准，由三个法院的判决构建而成。对于每个引用的条款，它都包含判决日期有效的文本和当前文本，其检索语料库包含泰国每个法条的所有版本。答案根据泰国律师协会的评分标准、律师标准分以及引用条款与法院条款之间的重叠程度进行评分。报告分为两部分。第一部分测量了13个开放权重模型中错误文本的成本。阅读修订后法律的当前文本会使律师标准分降低0.25，而遗漏废除的法律会使它降低0.79。这种惩罚来自规则变化，对428个规则变化的条款降低了0.45，而对331个仅文字修改的条款没有影响，引用F1分数也没有看到这一点。有效文本是公平的基准。第二部分在那种基准下对当前模型进行基准测试。一个公共排行榜对500个按领域分层划分的保留测试集上的26个模型进行排名，同时发布了一个形状相同的验证集供公众使用，仅通过内存、提供法院条款以及作为在有效法律上的检索代理，并记录每个项目的成本和虚构的引用。最佳模型得分为10分中的7.78分，最佳开放权重模型得分为6.39分。如果没有搜索工具，只有五个开放权重模型能回忆起任何泰国法律，而有了它，26个模型中有20个得分提高，6个得分降低。排行榜将随着新模型的发布不断更新。法律基准必须跟踪日期，即使使用正确的文本，当前模型在泰国法律方面仍然存在巨大差距。

articles.title: VeriHarm-Bench: Measuring Harmful Success in LLM Coding Agents Verifiably
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate with shell access, allowing them to write scripts, move files, alter permissions, and modify system configurations. However, an agent may achieve a user's goal while causing unintended harm, such as deleting unrelated files, weakening access controls, or corrupting data, in response to benign inputs without explicit jailbreaking. This failure mode is particularly important because apparent task success may reassure users that an agent behaved correctly, causing harmful side effects to go unnoticed. We call this harmful success: the agent successfully completes the intended benign task while simultaneously causing unintended harm. Despite its importance, harmful success is difficult to measure because conventional task-success metrics overlook harmful behaviors, while existing safety evaluations are often designed solely to assess harmful outcomes. We introduce VeriHarm, an automatic framework for constructing programmatically verifiable benchmarks that directly measure harmful success. VeriHarm minimally perturbs coding tasks to elicit unintended harmful behavior while maintaining the benignity of the task and preserving the original task objective. It then synthesizes executable harm tests that, together with the original task-correctness tests, evaluate both task accuracy and harmful outcomes. Frontier agents, including GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, achieve an average task accuracy of 95% on our curated VeriHarm-Bench, yet still struggle to complete tasks safely: their safe success rate, the fraction of tasks completed successfully without triggering the designated harm, averages only 37%. These results suggest that successful task completion can frequently coexist with unintended harm, and that task-success metrics alone may substantially understate the potential safety risks of coding agents.
articles.titleCn: VeriHarm-Bench：可验证地衡量LLM编程代理的有害成功
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码代理越来越多地拥有shell访问权限，这使它们能够编写脚本、移动文件、更改权限以及修改系统配置。然而，代理可能会在响应良性输入且未进行明确越狱的情况下，实现用户目标的同时造成未预期的损害，例如删除无关文件、削弱访问控制或破坏数据。这种失效模式尤其重要，因为明显的任务成功可能会让用户确信代理行为正确，从而导致有害的副作用未被察觉。我们将这种现象称为“有害成功”：代理成功完成预期的良性任务，同时造成未预期的损害。尽管其重要性，有害成功难以衡量，因为传统的任务成功指标忽略了有害行为，而现有的安全评估通常仅设计用于评估有害结果。我们引入了VeriHarm，这是一个自动化的框架，用于构建可编程验证的基准，直接衡量有害成功。VeriHarm最小程度地扰动编码任务，以引出未预期的有害行为，同时保持任务本身的良性并保留原始任务目标。然后，它合成可执行的损害测试，与原始的任务正确性测试相结合，评估任务准确性和有害结果。前沿代理，包括GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude-Opus-5，在我们的VeriHarm-Bench上实现了平均95%的任务准确率，但仍然难以安全地完成任务：它们的任务安全成功率，即成功完成任务且未触发指定损害的比例，平均仅为37%。这些结果表明，任务成功可以频繁与未预期的损害共存，而单独的任务成功指标可能严重低估了编码代理的潜在安全风险。

articles.title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
articles.abstract: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case's requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. We identify four bottlenecks in this engagement: (1) incomplete discovery, with 40% of withheld requirements missing or misrepresented; (2) unreliable execution; (3) underused compute budgets and a lack of systematic comparisons across base models and post-training methods; and (4) benchmark accuracy does not guarantee production readiness. We suggest human review of discovered requirements, monitoring of the agent's plan during execution, and an explicit experiment-environment specification covering hardware, budget scope, and production checks.
articles.titleCn: LLM代理能否作为前部署工程师？企业文本到SQL的需求发现与交付
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型编程代理可以越来越多地自动化模型训练后的工作，但它们是否能够作为前置部署工程师（FDE）代理，发现客户需求并将其转化为部署决策，目前尚不明确。我们在一个真实的商业文本到SQL项目中进行研究：一个基于真实用例需求的模拟客户，从一个模糊的请求开始。代理必须在发现阶段发现验收标准、数据权限和硬件限制，然后在交付阶段规划和执行训练后配方。在15个模型中，最强的发现超过80%的隐藏需求，而开放权重模型发现40-50%；在交付阶段，只有25%的八种编程代理配置运行通过所有验收标准。我们在这项工作中识别出四个瓶颈：（1）发现不完整，40%的隐藏需求缺失或表述不当；（2）执行不可靠；（3）计算预算使用不足，缺乏对基础模型和训练后方法的系统性比较；（4）基准准确率并不能保证生产就绪。我们建议对发现的需求进行人工审核，监控代理在执行过程中的计划，以及明确涵盖硬件、预算范围和生产检查的实验环境规范。

articles.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
articles.abstract: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 层库（LoL）：在运行时自适应排序Transformer层
articles.abstractCn: 计算机程序员通过以不同的顺序组合可重复使用的计算原语，例如条件语句或循环，来实现不同的算法。相比之下，现有的语言模型架构总是以相同的顺序执行其层。我们引入了层库（LoL）架构，该架构在推理过程中动态地排序其层以解决当前问题。LoL只有一个超参数，即其全局Transformer块库的大小，允许它在参数重用和稀疏性之间无缝切换，将密集、深度递归和专家混合架构的参数效率和FLOPs效率权衡统一在一个家族中。我们展示了LoL在文本数据预训练时，与上述三个基线模型实现了具有竞争力的性能。在合成的数独和迷宫数据上，我们观察到模型采用不同的层排序来实现不同的解决方案策略，并且我们可以干预路由，迫使模型对特定问题实例应用特定的解决方案策略。在多语言自然语言环境中，我们发现LoL根据语言和文字选择不同的层排序模式。类似地，我们在安全数据上训练LoL，并将探针拟合到其路由器输出上，发现这些探针能够以高AUROC区分安全文本和危险文本。LoL为未来模型动态组合自己的计算图提供了路径，从而实现更高效和可控的推理。

articles.title: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
articles.abstract: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model's internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.
articles.titleCn: VIAS：用于组织多值对齐与合规的价值隔离激活引导
articles.abstractCn: 组织越来越多地部署必须遵循组织价值观的大型语言模型代理。我们检验了激活引导（在生成过程中向模型的内部激活添加向量而不改变其权重）是否能在提示之外进一步提升合规性。由于大多数场景涉及多个价值观，我们专注于多值引导。构建这些向量的简单方法是对遵循场景相关所有价值观的响应与违反这些价值观的响应进行对比。然而，这为不同价值观产生了几乎相同的向量：它们捕捉的是通用合规信号而非单个价值观，这限制了它们在组合多个价值观时的使用。我们提出了值隔离激活引导（VIAS），它对比在两种提示下对同一场景的响应，一种列出所有相关价值观，另一种省略单个目标价值观。我们只保留一对向量，如果目标价值观从合规变为不合规，并且两种响应在其他价值观上仍达到最低合规水平。我们在PROTECT数据集上评估了VIAS，该数据集是一个职场合规数据集，其中每个场景都标记了21个价值观分类中的相关价值观。VIAS减少了价值观向量之间的重叠，使它们更适合多值引导，尽管这本身并不能实现对每个价值观的独立控制。结合提示，VIAS在Qwen2.5-7B模型上有69.6%的场景、Mistral-7B模型上有75.2%的场景、Phi-3.5-mini模型上有72.6%的场景中符合所有标记的价值观，在所有三个模型上都优于单独使用提示。

articles.title: Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training
articles.abstract: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. OLGA also distills online data streams by keeping a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples, which is re-distilled together with each new batch as it arrives. In the online setting, it outperforms the strongest selection-based continual baseline by 6.6 stream-AUC percentage points. Finally, our method scales to large data by pairing distillation with selection in a hybrid pipeline, letting selection handle the mild stage of compression and distillation the extreme one. It cuts runtime by 30\% versus distillation alone at similar accuracy, and beats the best selection-only pipeline by up to 12.6 percentage points.
articles.titleCn: 在线无标签梯度匹配用于持续语言模型训练
articles.abstractCn: 面向客户的产品中的语言模型必须持续更新，因为它们所处理的数据会随时间变化。由于在全部累积数据上进行再训练不切实际，每次更新应改为在包含迄今为止所有数据训练信号的小型示例集上运行。当前最强大的方法通过梯度匹配构建这个集合，该方法是合成训练梯度与全部数据相匹配的示例。然而，它们需要真实标签，在固定的快照上运行而非在增长的数据流上运行，并且在大型数据上运行缓慢。我们引入了\textbf{OLGA}，它克服了这些限制。它通过从模型的下一个词预测中提取梯度匹配目标来蒸馏未标记数据。在五个文本分类基准测试中，使用phi-1.5，它仅使用五个示例就比最强的选择基线提高了10个百分点。OLGA还通过保持合成示例的运行排练内存来蒸馏在线数据流，该内存与新到达的每个批次一起重新蒸馏。在在线设置中，它比最强的基于选择的选择持续基线高出6.6个流-AUC百分点。最后，我们的方法通过在混合管道中结合蒸馏和选择来扩展到大型数据，让选择处理轻微的压缩阶段，而蒸馏处理极端阶段。它在相似精度下将运行时间比单独蒸馏减少30%，并且比最佳仅选择管道高出最多12.6个百分点。

articles.title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
articles.abstract: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.

articles.titleCn: 优化框架，而非模型：为调查分析适配可自托管的最小智能体LLM
articles.abstractCn: 政府情报团队需要能够分析大型、混乱的证据集合的LLM代理，但安全和成本限制常常使得托管的前沿模型和广泛、难以审计的工具界面被排除在外。我们报告了CLEO：环境优化约束循环，这是一种将最小化代理框架适配到固定、可自托管的LLM的方法。给定一个专家验证的数据集，CLEO仅允许那些在保持通用性和可审计性的同时提高准确性的工具、护栏、内存策略和循环组件。在我们的保留数据集上，CLEO框架达到了83.8%的通过率，与最强的现成Claude Code SDK基线仅相差1.2分，同时体积小了两个数量级。

articles.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
articles.abstract: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research. We introduce IdeaTaste, a benchmark that scores an LLM by how closely the research proposals it writes from a literature snapshot frozen at 2025 match the work the same communities published in 2026. Our experiments span six contemporary language models and four research areas from established to emerging fields, covering more than 90{,}000 proposals in total. LLM agents fall well short of human communities in both the literature they cite and the ideas they state, reaching about 26\% of the human level on citation matching and only 18\% on idea matching. Their populations can cite as diversely as a community and take up its tasks and methods, yet rarely arrive at the concrete approaches and research plans it pursues. Neither richer field context nor larger populations substantially close this gap. In blinded expert review, AI proposals trail the 2026 papers least in presentation and most in expected success, echoing their gap in concrete approaches, and those whose ideas no human paper shares fare worst, suggesting weaker directions rather than overlooked opportunities. These results indicate that the main bottleneck in AI research taste lies less in finding the directions a community works on than in turning them into the concrete approaches it goes on to pursue. We release IdeaTaste as an open, continuously updated leaderboard (https://cxcscmu.github.io/IdeaTaste) that benchmarks contemporary AI proposals against future publication cycles.
articles.titleCn: IdeaTaste：大型语言模型是否共享人类研究者的研究品味？
articles.abstractCn: 研究品味，即判断该阅读什么、该追求哪些问题以及尝试哪些方法，正日益影响人工智能科学家的研究工作，然而，人们对这种品味能力的理解远不如对其执行研究能力的理解。我们介绍了IdeaTaste，这是一个基准，它通过评估大型语言模型从2025年冻结的文献快照中撰写的研究提案与同一社区在2026年发表的工作的匹配程度来评分。我们的实验涵盖了六个当代语言模型和四个从成熟到新兴领域的研究领域，总共涵盖了超过90,000个提案。LLM代理在引用的文献和提出的观点上均远不及人类社区，在引用匹配上达到人类水平的约26%，在观点匹配上仅为18%。它们的群体可以像社区一样多样化地引用，并承担其任务和方法，但很少达到其追求的具体方法和研究计划。更丰富的领域背景或更大的群体并不能显著缩小这一差距。在盲法专家评审中，AI提案在呈现方面落后于2026年的论文最少，在预期成功方面落后最多，这反映了它们在具体方法上的差距，而那些观点没有与任何人类论文共享的提案表现最差，这表明方向较弱而非被忽视的机会。这些结果表明，人工智能研究品味的主要瓶颈不在于找到社区正在研究的方向，而在于将这些方向转化为其随后追求的具体方法。我们发布了IdeaTaste作为一个开放的、持续更新的排行榜（https://cxcscmu.github.io/IdeaTaste），用于将当代AI提案与未来的发表周期进行基准测试。

articles.title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
articles.abstract: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.

articles.titleCn: 相同输出，不同分数：审计多模态LLM基准的未检查评分器
articles.abstractCn: 每个多模态-LLM 选择题基准测试都以一个评分规则结束，该规则将模型的响应（通常是自由文本而非清晰的选项字母）转换为正确/错误的判断，并将其嵌入在代码中。与数据集不同，这个规则未经任何论证就被选择，且未被审视，但它决定了发布的分数。我们在五个适配单个 16 GB GPU 的开放视觉语言模型（VLMs）上复现了八个同行评审基准测试的官方评分器，并引入了一种盲法人类加 LLM 评委裁决（Cohen's kappa=0.956），以恢复模型实际回答的内容。仅评分规则就能使准确率在相同输出上提高高达 22 分，但在模型发出清晰选项字母时却恰好为 0，因此它在强模型排行榜上隐藏了这一问题。是默认选项而非冗长回答造成了损害：我们测量的最高非合规基准测试具有完全为 0 的伪影，因为其评分器选择弃权而非猜测；一个合规度为 0.000 的推理模型，其跟踪记录的正则表达式匹配仍会导致 9.5 分的波动。没有标准的规则是可靠的：将未回答项强行匹配到最接近的选项会奖励从未给出的答案，同时埋没正确的答案；弃权会忽略用文字表述的答案；似然评分遵循答案标记先验，因此单一评分将能力与运气混淆，而非测量任何一方。我们发布所有代码、标签和协议，并主张基准测试应报告非合规率，并至少提供两种规则，而非一个未经审视的评分。

articles.title: Characterizing When Language Models Take Harmful Actions to Protect Their Assigned Goals
articles.abstract: Recent language model (LM) safety failures have largely been studied as disparate phenomena. In agentic misalignment, a model blackmails an executive to avoid being replaced. In alignment faking, it complies with harmful requests during training to keep its values from being modified. We argue that these behaviours share a common decision structure: a model assigned a goal must either take a harmful action to preserve it or refuse and lose it. We formalize this as a goal-harm conflict and present the same conflict under various elicitation protocols that range from compact forced-choice prompts to simulated agentic environments. These protocols span two perspectives on LM decision-making, which we term (i) the logit view, reading preferences from answer-token probabilities, and (ii) the sampling view, classifying open-ended responses with an LM judge. Under the logit view, we show that goal importance and harm severity additively shape how a model resolves these value conflicts. Under the sampling view, we derive two factorizations of the harmful-action probability that safety evaluations commonly report. The first measures how well a preference read from answer tokens carries over into behaviour, such as making a harmful tool call. The second attributes a low harmful-action rate either to refusal or to responses that reach no resolution. We then show how fictional context changes a model's preference under the logit view, and how tool use and partial observability -- two features of agentic evaluations -- change its harmful-action rate under the sampling view. Our work offers a descriptive framework for studying how LMs resolve such value conflicts and for estimating low-probability harmful actions at a finer granularity than the aggregate harm rates commonly reported in safety evaluations.
articles.titleCn: 描述语言模型何时为了保护其分配的目标而采取有害行为
articles.abstractCn: 近期语言模型（LM）的安全失效问题主要被作为孤立现象进行研究。在代理错位（agentic misalignment）中，模型通过威胁高管来避免被替换。在错位伪装（alignment faking）中，模型在训练期间遵从有害请求以保持其价值观不被修改。我们认为这些行为共享一个共同决策结构：被赋予目标的模型必须要么采取有害行动来保全目标，要么拒绝并失去目标。我们将此形式化为目标-危害冲突，并在不同诱导协议下呈现这一冲突，这些协议范围从紧凑的强制选择提示到模拟的代理环境。这些协议涵盖了关于LM决策的两种视角，我们称之为（i） logits视角，从答案标记概率中读取偏好，以及（ii）采样视角，通过LM裁判对开放式回答进行分类。在logits视角下，我们证明目标重要性和危害严重性加性影响模型如何解决这些价值冲突。在采样视角下，我们推导出安全评估中常见报告的有害行动概率的两个分解因子。第一个衡量从答案标记读取的偏好如何转化为行为，例如调用有害工具。第二个将低有害行动率归因于拒绝或未达成决议的回应。随后，我们展示了虚构情境如何在logits视角下改变模型的偏好，以及工具使用和部分可观测性——代理评估的两个特征——如何在采样视角下改变其有害行动率。我们的工作为研究LM如何解决此类价值冲突提供了一个描述性框架，并能在比安全评估中常见聚合危害率更细粒度的层面上估计低概率有害行动。

articles.title: Steering with Multilingual Lexicons for Sentiment Control in Low-Resource Languages
articles.abstract: Activation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling model behavior, but existing methods depend on sentence-level contrastive data that is unavailable for most of the world's languages. We show that multilingual sentiment lexicons are a viable substitute across three model families: aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain stronger for languages a model has specialized in during pre-training. The steering efficacy is mechanistically dictated by both representational density and pre-training priors. Large-magnitude English vectors overwhelm the compact representations of low-resource languages, causing "linguistic collapse." This fragility is mitigated by the norm-dampening of multilingual aggregation. Architectural biases, including bilingual specialization penalty and latent numerical rigidity, also heavily constrain cross-lingual steering responsiveness. Ultimately, our work establishes lexicons as a practical steering signal and offers a comprehensive mechanistic account of cross-lingual steering dynamics.
articles.titleCn: 使用多语言词汇进行低资源语言的情感控制
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导为控制模型行为提供了一种轻量级机制，但现有方法依赖于句子级别的对比数据，而这类数据对于世界上大多数语言来说并不存在。我们证明多语言情感词汇表在三个模型系列中都是可行的替代方案：聚合多语言词汇表在中等和低资源语言中优于英语衍生引导向量，而单语言词汇表对于模型在预训练期间专门研究的语言仍然更强。引导效能从机制上受到表示密度和预训练先验的共同影响。大幅度的英语向量会压倒低资源语言的紧凑表示，导致“语言崩溃”。这种脆弱性可以通过多语言聚合的范数衰减得到缓解。架构偏差，包括双语专门化惩罚和潜在数值刚性，也严重限制了跨语言引导的响应能力。最终，我们的工作将词汇表确立为一种实用的引导信号，并提供了对跨语言引导动态的全面机制解释。

articles.title: MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
articles.abstract: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: when given a correct caption in a non-English language and an incorrect one in English, models preferentially select the English caption. This bias varies considerably across architectures. Among the tested models, Gemma 3 shows the strongest English preference while Qwen 3 is the least biased, despite both reaching similar monolingual accuracy across languages. The code is available at https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco.
articles.titleCn: 多语言多目标图像修复：多语言细粒度视觉理解
articles.abstractCn: 先前研究表明，视觉语言（VL）模型难以理解细粒度的图像细节，且倾向于关注整体布局。此外，英语的任何弱点在多语言环境中往往会进一步放大。为了研究这一问题，我们将专注于细粒度视觉细节的英语数据集InpaintCOCO扩展到五语系中的13种类型多样的语言，创建了MultiInpaintCOCO——一个包含953个最小对例的新多语言基准。我们进一步在多语言多模态检索中测试了多种最先进模型，包括轻量级的VL CLIP类编码器和大型语言模型。我们的结果表明，对于低资源语言，性能显著下降，最强的预测因素是可用的数据资源而非与英语的类型学相似性。在跨语言检索中，大多数模型表现出对英语的系统偏见：当给定非英语的正确字幕和英语的错误字幕时，模型倾向于选择英语字幕。这种偏见在不同架构之间存在显著差异。在测试的模型中，Gemma 3表现出最强的英语偏好，而Qwen 3则最少存在偏见，尽管两者在多语言单语准确率上达到了相似水平。代码可在https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco获取。

articles.title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation

authors.name: Devesh Shah Antonio H. de O. Fonseca

articles.abstract: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.

articles.titleCn: 在质谱/质谱结构解析中，大型语言模型依赖专业工具进行分布外泛化
articles.abstractCn: 近期有研究报道了一种前沿语言模型能够在无需工具的情况下解决一维核磁共振结构解析问题。我们探究了这种能力是否能够迁移到串联质谱（MS/MS）的非从头开始（de novo）设置中，在该设置下，模型必须直接从光谱中提出结构，而无需候选列表或参考库。为了区分推理能力与回忆能力，我们从MassSpecGym构建了一个包含100种分析物的基准测试，并根据每种分析物的文本特征将其分为分布内（文献中有详细记载）和分布外（基本无文献记载）两个分支。我们保持模型、工具和输出格式固定，仅改变大型语言模型（LLM）对特定领域工具的访问权限。在无工具的情况下，前沿LLM在分布内达到52%的Top-1准确率，但在分布外仅为2%。只有访问从头开始结构生成器能够提高分布外的准确率，将其提升至高达38%的Top-1，并且由此产生的代理模型在分布内和分布外均优于独立的从头开始模型。这些结果表明，LLM在自身情况下并不擅长从头开始MS/MS结构解析，进一步的提升依赖于代理可用的专业工具，而非LLM本身。

articles.title: Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
articles.abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.
articles.titleCn: 特异性偏差与维基百科悖论：领域迁移下AI文本检测器的可解释人工智能分析
articles.abstractCn: 大规模语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用要求可靠地区分人类创作文本与合成文本。然而，当前的基于Transformer的检测器在领域迁移时往往性能严重下降，并且作为不透明的分类器运行。本文通过评估经过微调的Transformer模型（DistilBERT、RoBERTa）在自定义分布外（OOD）数据集上的鲁棒性和可解释性，该数据集由开源LLM（Llama 3、Mistral、Gemma）合成的超本地新闻组成。为分析模型决策边界，我们应用了基于SHAP的三分法可解释人工智能（xAI）框架。我们的分析揭示了三种关键现象：首先，检测器往往依赖指令微调LLM固有的“号召行动”综合征，而非通用机器文本。其次，我们观察到“特异性偏差”，即LLM通过臆造特定命名实体和模仿对话不完美来成功规避检测。最后，我们阐述了“维基百科悖论”，即正式、客观的人类写作由于统计突发性低而被频繁误判为AI。这些发现表明，纯统计检测范式在高度结构化的人类领域面临系统性局限，强调了语义感知、可解释检测架构的迫切需求。

articles.title: Do Agents Still Follow the Rules? Benchmarking Rule Compliance under Agent Context Compaction
articles.abstract: LLM agents compact long histories to fit their context windows, but the compacted context must still carry the operating rules that govern later actions. Prior work shows that violations rise after compaction, but measures compliance outside a complete agent harness and does not identify where each violation comes from. We introduce ARCBench(Agent Rule Compliance Benchmark), a configurable benchmark built on the open-source pi agent harness. Its tool-calling agent loop lets us measure rule compliance from actions taken during execution, bringing the evaluation closer to deployed agent workflows. Using ARCBench, we examine where violations after compaction come from, and how different compaction configurations and adversarial settings change their sources. We find that compaction rarely deletes the rule: most violations after compaction occur while the rule is still in the compacted history, with the agent treating a later request as permission, ignoring the rule, and proceeding anyway. Where violations come from depends on the configuration: how the rule is delivered decides whether the agent would break it even without compaction, while the compaction strategy and budget decide whether the rule survives. The strongest compactor-targeted attack more than doubles violations by corrupting the rule in the summary and changing how the agents behave, whereas the strongest defense restores the rule in most summary but still violates. Finally, retaining a rule does not guarantee compliance: compacted runs that retain the rule violate more than twice as often as runs with the full history.
articles.titleCn: 代理是否仍然遵循规则？在代理上下文压缩下对规则合规性进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理将长历史压缩以适应其上下文窗口，但压缩后的上下文仍需包含指导后续操作的操作规则。先前研究表明压缩后违规行为会上升，但这些方法在完整的代理框架之外测量合规性，且无法识别每项违规行为的来源。我们引入了ARCBench（代理规则合规基准），这是一个基于开源pi代理框架的可配置基准。其工具调用代理循环使我们能够测量执行过程中的规则合规性，使评估更接近实际部署的代理工作流程。使用ARCBench，我们考察了压缩后违规行为的来源，以及不同的压缩配置和对抗性设置如何改变其来源。我们发现压缩很少删除规则：压缩后的大多数违规行为发生在规则仍存在于压缩历史中时，代理将后续请求视为许可，忽略规则并继续执行。违规行为的来源取决于配置：规则的传递方式决定了代理是否会在未压缩的情况下违反规则，而压缩策略和预算则决定了规则是否得以存活。针对压缩器的最强攻击通过破坏摘要中的规则并改变代理行为，使违规行为增加一倍以上，而最强的防御措施虽然恢复了大多数摘要中的规则，但仍存在违规行为。最后，保留规则并不能保证合规性：保留规则的压缩运行比完整历史的运行违规频率高两倍以上。

articles.title: Written Once, Read Differently How Language Models Own Answers Steer Their Next Ones
articles.abstract: When a language model answers a yes/no question, that answer changes how it answers a different question about the same entity. We study this \emph{self-commitment} in 22 open-weight models from four families (0.5B--72B parameters), fixing the model's first answer and measuring the shift in its second across 3,600 question pairs about 120 entities. Each answer writes a \emph{commitment direction} into the residual stream. The similarity of two questions' directions predicts their coupling on held-out entities ($ρ= 0.43$--$0.85$), and ablating a single direction shared across topics leaves at most 17\% of the effect in every model. How this direction is read is far less stable: the reading circuit spreads across more attention heads as models grow, instruction tuning makes more questions read it in the opposite sense, and in one model changing only the system prompt reverses the circuit's sign. Ablating the direction while sparing the attention sink removes most of the coupling at under 1.3\% perplexity cost in 18 of 19 instruction-tuned models, though it shifts standalone answers in two. Without the sink spared, the direction's alignment with the leading principal component of ordinary text predicts which models pay a high cost. Written once, the commitment is read differently across scale, training and prompt.
articles.titleCn: 一旦写入，便以不同方式阅读：语言模型如何掌控答案，引导其后续生成
articles.abstractCn: 当一个语言模型回答一个是非问题时，这个答案会改变它对同一实体提出的另一个问题的回答。我们研究了这种\emph{自我承诺}现象，在四个家族（参数规模从0.5B到72B）的22个开放权重模型中，固定模型的第一个答案，并测量其在涉及120个实体的3600个问题对中第二个答案的变化。每个答案都会在残差流中写入一个\emph{承诺方向}。两个问题方向之间的相似度可以预测它们在未见实体上的耦合程度（$ρ= 0.43$--$0.85$），而移除跨主题共享的单个方向，在每个模型中最多保留17%的效应。这种方向的解读方式远不如写入方式稳定：随着模型规模的增长，解读电路会扩展到更多的注意力头；指令微调使得更多的问题以相反的语义解读它；在某个模型中仅更改系统提示就能逆转电路的符号。在19个经过指令微调的模型中，移除方向解读电路但保留注意力汇流，可在低于1.3%困惑度成本的情况下消除大部分耦合，尽管这会改变两个独立答案的表现。如果没有保留注意力汇流，方向的文本主成分对齐预测了哪些模型会付出高昂代价。一旦写入，承诺的解读方式会随着规模、训练和提示的不同而变化。

articles.title: Dhārā Bench: An Evidence-Oriented Retrieval Benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems
articles.abstract: Dhārā Bench is a retrieval benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS), with 325 questions in 12 categories and 60,121 text chunks from 15 source groups. The categories were developed based on 4,500 questions submitted to the Dhārā application; the evaluation set combines corpus-aligned application queries with expert-contributed questions. The annotations comprise 7,578 question-chunk relevance links involving 6,847 distinct corpus chunks. For 34 composite and multi-hop questions, 401 conjugate groups specify alternative sets of passages that jointly support each question. Chunk identifiers and hierarchical references connect the judgments to their source texts. The paper describes corpus preparation, annotation, and validation, and reports a fixed BM25 baseline implemented with Pyserini with $k_1=0.9$ and $b=0.4$. Across all questions, BM25 achieves MRR@20 of 0.315, Recall@10 of 0.182, and nDCG@10 of 0.205. On the group-annotated subset, complete-evidence scores are CE_Recall@20 = 0.294 and CE_MRR@20 = 0.141. The category results expose particularly weak verse retrieval, while group scores reveal gaps between finding individual passages and completing their support. The corpus and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench.
