articles.titleCn: Dhārā Bench：面向印度知识体系的证据导向检索基准
articles.abstractCn: Dhārā Bench是一个用于印度知识系统（IKS）的检索基准，包含12个类别中的325个问题以及来自15个源组的60,121个文本片段。这些类别基于提交给Dhārā应用的4,500个问题开发而成；评估集结合了语料库对齐的应用查询和专家贡献的问题。标注包括7,578个问题-片段相关性链接，涉及6,847个不同的语料库片段。对于34个复合和多跳问题，401个共轭组指定了共同支持每个问题的替代片段集。片段标识符和层次参考将判断与源文本连接起来。论文描述了语料库准备、标注和验证过程，并报告了一个使用Pyserini实现的固定BM25基线，参数为$k_1=0.9$和$b=0.4$。在所有问题中，BM25实现了MRR@20为0.315，Recall@10为0.182，nDCG@10为0.205。在组标注子集上，完整证据得分为CE_Recall@20 = 0.294和CE_MRR@20 = 0.141。类别结果揭示了特别薄弱的诗歌检索能力，而组得分则显示出在找到单个片段和完成其支持之间存在的差距。语料库和评估代码可在https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench获取。

articles.title: ACTOR: Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents
articles.abstract: Large language agents for literary role-playing are typically modeled around dialogue generation, leaving characters' non-dialogue behaviors and their dynamic evolution over story time underrepresented. In this paper, we propose ACTOR (Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents), an automated framework for constructing such behavior trajectories from raw novel texts. ACTOR extracts dialogue and persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors, represents each behavior using a Thought-Action-Observation structure, and organizes behavior trajectories according to the internal temporal order of the story. We build a behavior dataset from 143 diverse literary works. For each source behavior, we generate counterfactual behaviors that are contextually plausible yet inconsistent with the character's persona. We find that existing models struggle to reliably infer character-consistent actions from historical behaviors and evolving character states. Using these behavior pairs, we train models with Regularized Preference Optimization (RPO), which augments DPO with a negative log-likelihood loss on the source behavior to jointly optimize behavior preference and generation. We further design a four-way next-behavior selection task to evaluate the model's ability to faithfully mimic character actions. Across 17,560 evaluation instances, the model trained on ACTOR's preference pairs achieves substantially improved accuracy. This result demonstrates that structured, temporally organized supervision enables models to leverage character profiles and prior behaviors to infer subsequent actions, greatly advancing literary role-playing beyond mere dialogue imitation. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SilentStar233/ACTOR.
articles.titleCn: 以行动为中心的文学角色扮演代理的时间组织
articles.abstractCn: 用于文学角色扮演的大型语言代理通常以对话生成为核心进行建模，导致角色非对话行为及其在故事时间中的动态演变被忽视。在本文中，我们提出了ACTOR（面向文学角色扮演代理的行动中心时序组织框架），这是一个从原始小说文本中自动构建此类行为轨迹的框架。ACTOR提取对话和与角色相关的非对话行为，使用思维-行动-观察结构来表示每种行为，并根据故事的内部分时序组织行为轨迹。我们从143部多样化的文学作品中构建了一个行为数据集。对于每个源行为，我们生成在上下文中合理但与角色人格不一致的对照行为。我们发现现有模型难以从历史行为和角色状态演变中可靠地推断符合角色特征的行为。使用这些行为对，我们通过正则化偏好优化（RPO）训练模型，该模型在源行为上添加负对数似然损失来增强DPO，以联合优化行为偏好和生成。我们进一步设计了一个四向后续行为选择任务，以评估模型忠实地模仿角色行为的能力。在17,560个评估实例中，在ACTOR的偏好对上训练的模型显著提高了准确率。这一结果表明，结构化的、时序组织的监督使模型能够利用角色资料和先前的行为来推断后续行为，极大地推进了文学角色扮演，超越了单纯的对话模仿。代码和数据可在https://github.com/SilentStar233/ACTOR获取。

articles.title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions
articles.abstract: People often attach instructions to their search queries, asking for pages written for beginners, documents in a certain language or official sources only. Most rerankers were trained to judge topical relevance and treat such instructions as a few extra words. On the InfoSearch benchmark, even GPT-4o used as a list-wise reranker reaches an average WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) of only 33.5. We present DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), a zero-shot reranker that splits an instructed query into a topic and a short list of typed clauses. A small judge model answers one narrow question per clause, and the answer probabilities are multiplied into a single score. Nothing is trained, and the configuration was frozen before the test runs. Reranking the same top-100 candidates as the published baselines, DMReranker reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9. It trails GPT-4o on the stricter SICR (Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio) metric, 19.2 against 32.1. We show that this gap follows from how a product of probabilities behaves when SICR compares raw scores across runs. Computed from ranks, our SICR is 67.0. On the same judge, splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 over a single combined question, while raw-score SICR falls. Scoring all six dimensions cost about $10 at list price.
articles.titleCn: 每一条子句都很重要：通过乘以小而可回答的问题进行指令跟随重新排序
articles.abstractCn: 人们常在搜索查询中附加指令，要求提供面向初学者的页面、特定语言的文档或仅官方来源的内容。大多数重排序器被训练用于判断主题相关性，并将此类指令视为额外的几个词语。在InfoSearch基准测试中，即使作为列表式重排序器使用的GPT-4o，其平均WISE（加权指令敏感性评估）也仅为33.5。我们提出了DMReranker（决策模型重排序器），这是一种零样本重排序器，它将带指令的查询拆分为一个主题和一组简短的类型化子句。一个小型判断模型对每个子句回答一个狭窄的问题，并将答案概率相乘得到一个单一分数。没有任何内容被训练，配置在测试运行前已冻结。与已发布的基线重排序相同的Top-100候选结果，DMReranker在所有六个InfoSearch维度上达到宏观WISE 50.9，同时保持原始模式nDCG@10为82.9。在更严格的SICR（严格指令合规率）指标上，它落后于GPT-4o，19.2对32.1。我们表明，这一差距源于当SICR跨运行比较原始分数时概率乘积的行为方式。基于排名计算，我们的SICR为67.0。在同一个判断模型上，将指令拆分使单个组合问题的WISE从32.9提高到47.6，而原始分数SICR则下降。评估所有六个维度的大约花费了100美元的标价。

articles.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
articles.abstract: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.
articles.titleCn: CoworkOS：为现实自动化扩展代理同事
articles.abstractCn: 协作代理的快速发展正推动人机协作向现实世界自动化转型，提供软件、设计及其他成果。然而，此类生产力工作既要求在复杂生产力任务上实现高质量交付，又要求在长期范围内持续监控和决策，这种结合仍是一个开放性挑战。我们介绍了CoworkOS，这是一个用于长期工作的通用框架，将任务策略与执行管理分离：模型决定行动、委派和接受，而运行时维护状态和反馈。其三层架构允许在稳定责任下直接执行或将任务委派给子代理，同步或异步进行。通过共享应用层，人类和代理可以检查和修改相同的演进文档、演示文稿、CAD模型和Blender场景，因此人机参与可以通过对话和直接修改工作本身进入。为保持跨代理和会话的连续性，CoworkOS进一步引入了分层工作空间和持久语义记忆，使工作文件、关键决策和长期运行的任务日志在中断后仍可共享、重用和续接。在12项基准测试和6类实际应用中，CoworkOS在与Codex和DeepSeek Harness等前沿代理应用相比中展现出高度竞争力。作为持续工作的案例研究，CoworkOS以GLM-5.3为核心，对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行RSI驱动的自动后训练。经过五轮迭代，模型在八项基准测试中的平均得分从33.19提升至42.95（+9.76）。展望未来，我们相信CoworkOS为通用协作代理智能开辟了一条有意义的路径。

articles.title: ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform
articles.abstract: On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouched units as controls, and 400 addresses appear without diacritics. The tables agree with an independent lineage on 10,564 of 10,565 official pairs, disagreements were settled against the resolutions, and the probing-track scorer agrees with both authors' blind labels (Cohen's $κ=0.91$ and $0.89$). Data, outputs, code, and a datasheet are released. In the probing track, at least 20 of 67 models know the reform. Fourteen of them give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses (old province only: 14-100%); a bare date recovers up to 100%. Post hoc (80 province-free addresses, single runs), with reasoning off, today's date in the system prompt leaves 68-100% old-province-only answers for 10 of 12 models; with reasoning, an "as of" prefix in the question leaves none for seven of eight. On the 1,262-item benchmark subset, with same-source old and new passages, small models unaware of the reform give 14-30% outdated answers and the five benchmark-track knowers (also differing in size or provider) 0-5%.
articles.titleCn: ViAdminShift：一个基于2025年行政改革构建的事件级知识更新越南基准
articles.abstractCn: 2025年7月1日，越南将原有的63个省份缩减为34个，废除696个市镇，并将10,035个村级单位（街道）替换为3,321个。ViAdminShift是一个关于这一事件的越南语资源，包含7,995个基准项，2,281个来自改革前后维基百科修订版本和带日期模板的检索段落，以及从官方转换表重建的旧到新表格（未重新分发）。更改项存储改革前的答案（除121个地址项外），$2\times2$设计使用未受影响的单位作为对照，400个地址未显示变音符号。表格与独立谱系在10,565个官方对中的10,564个对上达成一致，分歧已根据决议解决，探测轨道评分器与两位作者的盲标签（Cohen's $κ=0.91$和$0.89$）均一致。数据、输出、代码和数据表已发布。在探测轨道中，至少有20个模型中的67个模型知道改革。其中14个模型在关于旧地址的纯问题中（仅旧省份：14-100%）最多给出11%的新省份答案；一个纯日期可恢复高达100%。事后分析（80个无省份地址，单次运行），关闭推理时，系统提示中的当前日期使12个模型中的10个模型给出68-100%仅旧省份的答案；开启推理时，问题中的“截至”前缀使8个模型中的7个模型给出零个旧省份答案。在包含1,262项的基准子集上，具有相同来源的旧和新段落，未意识到改革的微型模型给出14-30%的过时答案，而五个基准轨道的知情者（大小或提供者不同）给出0-5%的答案。

articles.title: DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
articles.abstract: Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.
articles.titleCn: 深度迁移：通过分层跨层键值重建的结构正则化
articles.abstractCn: 深度扩展是构建更强大大型语言模型的关键途径，但预LN架构往往因深度方向的信息稀释而受限，限制了深层的有效利用。尽管跨层连接已被证明能有效缓解这一问题，但现有设计通常会增加额外的计算或内存访问。我们重新审视跨层KV共享作为一种高效的连接形式。除了缓存压缩外，每条KV重用边都为深层与源KV投影之间创建了直接的梯度路径，将KV共享转化为对KV表示几何结构的隐式结构正则化器。我们对这一机制进行了系统性分析，表明适当的共享拓扑能够锐化键检索方向，同时丰富值内容子空间，而现有的相邻或全局锚点设计未能充分利用这一效果。基于此，我们提出了DepthGraft，一种分层KV共享架构，它从步长对齐的浅层-中层源对中重建深层KV。DepthGraft在源层间分配非局部梯度流，同时保留预填充早期完成并减少约三分之一的KV缓存。在参数规模从0.5B到16B的密集和MoE模型上的实验表明，在GQA和MLA两种设置下均实现了持续的下游改进。值得注意的是，在16B的MoE模型上，DepthGraft在MMLU-Pro上实现了7.0%的绝对提升，同时在CMMLU和C3上分别获得了6.6%和6.4%的提升。这些结果验证了DepthGraft作为大规模预训练可扩展设计的潜力。项目页面可在https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft访问。

articles.title: Meet Students Where They Are: Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation for On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) mitigates the student's exposure bias by optimizing on student-generated trajectories. However, student-generated prefixes may contain reasoning errors or follow patterns unfamiliar to the teacher, undermining the reliability of its token-level supervision. This degradation becomes more pronounced as prefixes grow longer. To address this teacher-side distribution mismatch, we propose Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation (SPTA), which adapts the teacher to the states on which it is queried during distillation. Specifically, before OPD starts, we collect student rollout prefixes with random lengths and continually train the teacher to continue from the prefixes using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). By treating each prefix as context and rewarding correct final answers, the teacher learns to recover from student-induced states rather than imitate the student's reasoning. Then, the adapted teacher is used for standard OPD, with no changes to the distillation objective. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that our SPTA improves average student performance over standard OPD and OPD with task-level RLVR-adapted teachers. These results highlight the importance of adapting teachers not only to solve problems independently, but also to provide reliable guidance on the states their students actually visit.
articles.titleCn: 面向学生进行前缀教师自适应策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过优化学生生成的轨迹来减轻学生的暴露偏差。然而，学生生成的轨迹前缀可能包含推理错误或遵循教师不熟悉的模式，从而削弱其标记级别的监督可靠性。随着前缀长度的增加，这种退化现象会更加明显。为了解决这种教师端的分布不匹配问题，我们提出了学生前缀教师适应（SPTA），该方法使教师适应其在蒸馏过程中被查询的状态。具体而言，在OPD开始之前，我们收集随机长度的学生轨迹前缀，并使用具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）持续训练教师，以从这些前缀继续推理。通过将每个前缀视为上下文，并奖励正确的最终答案，教师学会从学生诱导的状态中恢复，而不是模仿学生的推理过程。然后，使用适应后的教师进行标准的OPD，蒸馏目标保持不变。在数学推理基准测试上的实验表明，我们的SPTA比标准的OPD和具有任务级RLVR适应的教师OPD提高了学生的平均性能。这些结果突出了适应教师不仅需要独立解决问题，还需要为其学生实际访问的状态提供可靠指导的重要性。

articles.title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at CIKM 2026, November 8, 2026, Rome, Italy
articles.titleCn: 微调数据预处理的选择至关重要：基于大型语言模型的推荐中的效用与人口统计敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）为推荐引入了生成式方法，通过用户历史记录和物品信息的文本表示生成物品列表。然而，这种生成式设置带来了关于输出有效性、提示一致性和对人口统计描述敏感性的挑战。在这项工作中，我们研究了微调数据中的预处理选择如何影响基于生成式LLM的推荐系统中的推荐效用和公平性相关行为。我们首先建立了一个受控的推荐流程，该流程结合了监督微调、目录约束解码和提示增强。然后，我们研究了三种预处理选择：物品标题表示、人口统计平衡和辅助物品知识丰富。在MovieLens-1M上的实验表明，目录约束流程消除了目录外物品并确保了完整的十件物品输出，而提示增强提高了提示一致性和效用。原始MovieLens标题将HR@10从10.67%提高到12.47%，Coverage@10从41.36%提高到47.88%。公平性相关效果与属性相关：年龄平衡和知识丰富减少了所选群体级别的效用差距，同时基本保留了效用，而性别平衡降低了效用，且未改善评估的性别相关指标。总体而言，微调数据中的预处理选择应从效用、输出行为和人口统计敏感性等方面进行综合评估。

articles.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.
articles.titleCn: DR Pixel：面向页面的原生深度研究，结合视觉-语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 像科学论文这样的复杂文档中包含着丰富的表格、图表和公式信息；然而，现有的深度研究（DR）代理通常将论文简化为OCR提取的文本。我们则提出，视觉语言模型（VLMs）能否实现页面原生的深度研究：直接从渲染的文档页面图像中检索和推理。我们引入了DR Pixel，首个开源端到端多模态深度研究代理，它将渲染的页面图像作为其唯一的检索和推理单元，在包含1.06M页面的语料库上运行。为了评估这一设置，我们构建了DRPixelBench，这是一个要求在文本、图表、表格和公式上进行推理的科学论文基准。令人惊讶的是，页面原生的DR在未经训练的情况下就已经表现良好，其性能优于基于OCR的基线，并在GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.5-Flash和Qwen3.6-27B等最先进的模型上取得领先，同时所需的工具调用次数更少。接下来，我们转向DR训练。一个关键挑战是，用于代理监督微调的教师轨迹是嘈杂的，混合了关键的推理和行动步骤与冗余或失败的尝试。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了反事实信用重新加权，这是一种细粒度的信用分配方法，根据单个推理和行动步骤对最终答案的反事实贡献来为其加权。我们的训练将DRPixelBench上的检索召回率提高了约15个百分点，最终准确率提高了超过10个百分点，并且同样在四个现有的基准上超越了未经训练的基线。在分布外数据集ViDoRe-V3上，DR Pixel与直接获得金页面的预言机仅相差1.8个百分点。我们的结果表明，传统的OCR后再检索流程不仅是不必要的，而且次优：直接从视觉文档页面中检索和推理，使复杂DR既更有效又更高效。

articles.title: An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
articles.abstract: Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both models agree and defaulting to Not Enough Evidence otherwise, combines their strengths. We construct a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact (858 Support, 152 Contradict, 1,025 Not Enough Evidence). We retrieve the top five most relevant sentences per claim using a hybrid of semantic and lexical (BM25) retrieval, which slightly outperforms either method alone. These retrieved sentences are then provided to every verification model. We then compare a DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI baseline against Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B. Qwen3 achieves the highest Macro-F1 (0.7937), followed by Llama 3.1 (0.7204) and Mistral (0.6388), while the NLI baseline reaches only 0.3157. Contrary to our hypothesis, fusion degrades performance, dropping Macro-F1 to 0.7392, 0.6730, and 0.5991, respectively. To understand this decline, we analyze agreements, disagreements, and common error patterns between the NLI and LLM verifiers. Our error analysis shows that NLI and LLM disagreements often result in correct LLM predictions being overturned.
articles.titleCn: 一项关于混合检索、自然语言推理和开源大型语言模型在科学声明验证中的实验研究
articles.abstractCn: 声明验证的任务是判断源文本是否支持一个声明、与之矛盾，或缺乏足够的证据。自然语言推理（NLI）模型可以判断单个句子是否支持或矛盾于声明，但当证据分散在多个句子中时，它们会感到困难。相反，大型语言模型（LLM）可以在句子间进行推理，但可能会得出文本并不支持的结论。在这项实验研究中，我们测试了保守融合规则是否结合了它们的优点：仅在两个模型都同意时标记声明为“支持”或“矛盾”，否则默认为“证据不足”。我们从SciFact和CliniFact中构建了一个包含2,035个声明的基准（858个支持，152个矛盾，1,025个证据不足）。我们使用语义和词汇（BM25）检索的组合，为每个声明检索最相关的五个句子，这种方法略微优于单独使用任何一种方法。然后，我们将这些检索到的句子提供给每个验证模型。随后，我们将DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI基线与Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen3 8B和Mistral 7B进行比较。Qwen3达到了最高的宏F1（0.7937），其次是Llama 3.1（0.7204）和Mistral（0.6388），而NLI基线仅为0.3157。与我们的假设相反，融合降低了性能，将宏F1分别降至0.7392、0.6730和0.5991。为了理解这种下降，我们分析了NLI和LLM验证器之间的协议、分歧和常见错误模式。我们的错误分析表明，NLI和LLM之间的分歧常常导致LLM的正确预测被推翻。

articles.title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
articles.abstract: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.
articles.titleCn: 化身智能：通过持久个人代理增强人类能动性
articles.abstractCn: 个人AI代理在处理跨应用的长时程任务方面能力日益增强，但用户往往需要投入大量精力来明确目标、解决模糊性并验证结果。我们认为，进步应通过代理有效增强人类能动性的程度来衡量：即让人们能以更少的常规监督来追求目标，同时保留对重大决策的控制权。我们倡导"化身智能"这一范式，它是一种持续性的个人代理，通过在跨情境和跨时间的过程中持续委托决策来代表用户的目标、价值观和约束条件。我们描述了从人类主导执行到自主操作的分阶段成熟路线图，并引入了"代理监督指数"(AOI)作为评估交付价值相对于代理端操作成本和人类监督负担的框架。我们确定了三个核心研究挑战：跨任务传递用户偏好的身份持续性个性化、通过排练工程实现用户情境化进化，以及结合技术控制、问责制和补救措施的安全机制。这些方向为可靠地将决策委托给个人代理的研究议程奠定了基础，涵盖任务和时间维度。

articles.title: SAGE (Subjectivity-Aware Generation Estimator): A Linguistic Framework for AI-Generated Review Detection *
articles.abstract: We propose a simple, linguistically motivated approach to detecting AI-generated peer reviews based on the inherently human trait of subjectivity. We capture subjectivity at two levels: the semantic level of evaluative language and modality and the pragmatic level of speech acts. Using features derived from speech act annotations and model-predicted subjectivity scores, we train a lightweight classifier that achieves an AUROC of 0.9566 with only these linguistic features. Combining its output with the state-of-the-art detector Sem-Detect raises the TPR at 1% FPR of Sem-Detect on the APRDB benchmark from 0.874 to 0.985, outperforming the current state of the art. Our results show that linguistic features of subjectivity provide an explainable source of information for detecting AI-generated peer reviews and can be readily integrated into existing detection methods. The code and models are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/Arys02/generated\_ text\_detection\_hub) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/Arys02), respectively.
articles.titleCn: SAGE（主观性感知生成估计器）：一种用于AI生成评论检测的语言框架
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种基于人类主观性这一固有特征的简单、语言学驱动的检测方法，用于识别AI生成的同行评审。我们在两个层面捕捉主观性：评估语言的语义层面和情态层面，以及言语行为的语用层面。利用从言语行为标注中提取的特征和模型预测的主观性评分，我们训练了一个轻量级分类器，仅使用这些语言学特征即可实现0.9566的AUROC。将它的输出与当前最先进的检测器Sem-Detect结合，在APRDB基准测试上将Sem-Detect在1% FPR下的TPR从0.874提升至0.985，超越了当前最先进水平。我们的结果表明，主观性的语言学特征为检测AI生成的同行评审提供了可解释的信息来源，并且可以方便地集成到现有的检测方法中。代码和模型分别公开发布在GitHub（https://github.com/Arys02/generated_text_detection_hub）和Hugging Face（https://huggingface.co/Arys02）。

articles.title: Unlocking Criminal Court Decisions: Flexible Information Extraction for Empirical Legal Research
articles.abstract: Criminal verdicts contain descriptions of criminal behavior that can support quantitative legal research, but structuring them requires attributes and extraction rules that cannot always be fully specified in advance. We present an LLM-based pipeline that builds a structured dataset through attribute exploration, text span extraction, and value normalization, guided by annotation instructions that legal experts can refine. We evaluate it on two traffic offenses: driving under the influence (DUI) and driving despite a ban (DDB). For DUI, revising the instructions was associated with higher extraction accuracy (from 52% to 70% of correctly extracted values) and higher agreement between human annotators. Repeated runs of the same model agreed with each other more than with the gold annotations, showing that consistent output is not necessarily correct, while disagreement between annotators and between models helped reveal unclear instructions. For DDB, where the instructions defined fixed categories and output formats, agreement was high for most attributes.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Legal Knowledge and Information Systems (JURIX 2026)
articles.titleCn: 解锁刑事法院判决：灵活信息提取助力实证法律研究
articles.abstractCn: 刑事判决书包含可支持量化法律研究的犯罪行为描述，但构建这些数据需要属性和提取规则，而这些规则并不总是可以事先完全指定。我们提出一个基于大型语言模型的流程，通过属性探索、文本片段提取和值归一化构建结构化数据集，该流程在法律专家可细化的标注指令指导下进行。我们在两项交通犯罪上评估了该流程：酒驾（DUI）和禁驾（DDB）。对于酒驾，修订指令与更高的提取准确率（正确提取值从52%提高到70%）和人类标注者之间更高的协议相关。相同模型的重复运行彼此之间比与金标准标注更一致，表明一致输出未必正确，而标注者之间和模型之间的不一致有助于揭示模糊的指令。对于禁驾，由于指令定义了固定的类别和输出格式，大多数属性的一致性都很高。

articles.title: VERS: Steering Reasoning Models by Editing Their Activation Explanations
articles.abstract: Reasoning language models write a chain of thought before they answer, and many checks in it do not change the final answer. Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) explain a model's activations in text and rebuild activations from text, and editing an explanation can steer a model at a single token. We study whether such edits can also steer how a model reasons. We build VERS (Verbalize, Edit, Reconstruct, Steer): it turns explanation edits at the doubt points of one reasoning trace into one fixed direction, and adds this direction at paragraph breaks. On the full GSM8K test, VERS cuts generated tokens by 45.8% at an accuracy change of -0.82 percentage points (pp); on MATH-500 it saves 31.3% at -3.05 pp. At half strength, its trade-off between tokens and accuracy lies between those of the published methods SEAL and DEER. With fitted affine maps and a strength tuned for each model, the direction transfers to larger Qwen3 models, up to 235B-A22B, and saves 30-35% of tokens. On competition problems, however, VERS loses 3-7 pp at every model size, and a fixed direction did not separate necessary checks from unneeded ones.
articles.titleCn: 版本：通过编辑它们的激活解释来引导推理模型
articles.abstractCn: 推理语言模型在回答问题前会进行一系列思考，其中许多检查并不会改变最终答案。自然语言自动编码器（NLAs）通过文本解释模型的激活状态，并从文本中重建激活状态，编辑解释可以引导模型在单个词元上进行调整。我们研究了这种编辑是否也能引导模型进行推理。我们构建了VERS（Verbalize, Edit, Reconstruct, Steer）：它将推理轨迹中怀疑点的解释编辑转化为一个固定方向，并在段落断点处添加这个方向。在完整的GSM8K测试集上，VERS在准确率下降0.82个百分点（pp）的情况下，减少了生成词元数量的45.8%；在MATH-500上，它节省了31.3%的词元，准确率下降3.05 pp。在半强度下，它在词元数量和准确率之间的权衡介于已发表的SEAL和DEER方法之间。通过适配仿射映射，并针对每个模型调整强度，这个方向可以转移到更大的Qwen3模型，最高可达235B-A22B，节省了30-35%的词元。然而，在竞赛问题中，VERS在每种模型规模下都损失了3-7个百分点的准确率，固定的方向未能区分必要的检查和不必要的检查。

articles.title: Finding Errors Is Not Enough: Selective Model Escalation for Entity-Targeted Sentiment Analysis
articles.abstract: Improving a sentiment classifier with limited resources involves more than simply deciding how much data to collect or which model to train. A labelled collection may lack examples of an important class. Once trained, a classifier may benefit from another model even when that model is weaker on its own. We study these decisions in document-level Entity-Level Sentiment Analysis (ELSA), primarily using South Slavic news. We first compare acquisition orders as collections grow. We then use uncertainty to choose which predictions to revisit, how many to process, and whether an alternative encoder or local LLM can correct them. Finally, we select complete routing policies on development data for held-out evaluation. Minority-prioritised acquisition helps at some very small training sizes, but not consistently thereafter. On SentiCoref, an oracle correcting all errors in the least-confident 10% without harming correct predictions would add 9.14 Macro-F1 points; however the best evaluated action gains only 0.90. Encoder averaging helps on AspectBench and NewsMTSC but harms SentiCoref, where selective LLM assistance is more promising. Both development-selected policies route 30% of records to the encoder-assisted LLM, yielding observed gains of 1.02 points on SentiCoref (interval includes zero) and 1.71 on NewsMTSC, at substantially different inference costs.
articles.titleCn: 发现错误并不足够：针对实体目标情感分析的Selective Model Escalation
articles.abstractCn: 在资源有限的情况下改进情感分类器，不仅仅是决定收集多少数据或训练哪个模型那么简单。一个标记集合可能缺乏重要类别的示例。一旦训练完成，分类器即使在使用单独效果较弱的模型时也可能受益。我们研究了这些决策在文档级实体级情感分析（ELSA）中的应用，主要使用南斯拉夫语系新闻。我们首先比较了随着集合增长时的获取顺序。然后，我们使用不确定性来选择哪些预测需要重新审视、需要处理多少以及是否可以使用替代编码器或本地LLM来纠正它们。最后，我们在开发数据上选择完整的路由策略用于保留评估。少数优先获取策略在极小的训练规模时有所帮助，但之后并不始终有效。在SentiCoref上，一个能够纠正最不确定的10%中的所有错误且不影响正确预测的预言者将增加9.14个宏观F1分；然而，最佳评估动作仅能增加0.90分。编码器平均在AspectBench和NewsMTSC上有所帮助，但在SentiCoref上则有害，其中选择性LLM辅助更有前景。开发数据选择的策略将30%的记录路由到编码器辅助的LLM，在SentiCoref上观察到1.02分的增益（区间包含零），在NewsMTSC上观察到1.71分的增益，但推理成本差异很大。

articles.title: Distilling Literary Sentiment from LLM Annotations into an Ordinal BERT Model
articles.abstract: The scarcity of human-annotated literary corpora limits the development of domain-specific sentiment analysis models. This study investigates whether LLM-generated annotations can supervise smaller models for literary sentiment analysis. We fine-tune five BERT models using ordinal regression on 10,889 literary sentences annotated by Gemma 4 31B on a ten-point sentiment scale. The models are evaluated against 1,923 human-annotated sentences from Hemingway's "The Old Man and the Sea", alongside the teacher model and conventional baselines. BERT-large achieves a Kendall's $τ$ of 0.589, approaching the teacher's 0.604. Although a constant-neutral predictor achieves the lowest overall mean absolute error (MAE), BERT-base outperforms the teacher on non-neutral sentences, achieving an MAE of 0.726 versus 1.116. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLM-generated supervision for developing smaller literary sentiment models, while highlighting the limitations of aggregate error metrics on predominantly neutral datasets.
articles.titleCn: 从LLM标注中提炼文学情感并构建有序BERT模型
articles.abstractCn: 人类标注的文学语料库的稀缺性限制了特定领域情感分析模型的发展。本研究探讨了大型语言模型生成的标注是否能够指导小型模型进行文学情感分析。我们使用Gemma 4 31B在十点情感量表上标注的10,889个文学句子，通过序数回归对五个BERT模型进行微调。这些模型在海明威的《老人与海》中1,923个人类标注句子、教师模型以及传统基线模型上进行了评估。BERT-large达到了Kendall's $τ$为0.589，接近教师模型的0.604。尽管恒定中性预测器实现了最低的整体平均绝对误差（MAE），但BERT-base在非中性句子上的表现优于教师模型，其MAE为0.726，而教师模型为1.116。这些发现表明，大型语言模型生成的监督具有开发小型文学情感模型的潜力，同时也突显了在以中性数据为主的集合中，总误差指标存在的局限性。

articles.title: Specification-Aware Predictive Uncertainty Decomposition
articles.abstract: Classical decompositions of predictive uncertainty, such as the information-theoretic one, are defined for a fixed representation $x$ of the input object. They do not consider that $x$ may be incomplete, nor do they measure how much the missing information can affect the prediction. In Large Language Models, users can clarify an underspecified input without any retraining. The clarified input can describe the user's unobserved intent $z^*$ more accurately and change the predictive uncertainty about the outcome. In this paper, we formalize this setting probabilistically and derive a three-term decomposition of prediction risk into specification, residual aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainties. We show that at the original information level, when only $x$ is available, the aleatoric uncertainty, represented by a Bayes risk, has two components. The first, which we call specification uncertainty, is the expected reduction in this Bayes risk from revealing the intent. The second is the residual aleatoric uncertainty, i.e., the Bayes risk that remains once the intent is known, averaged over its possible values $z$ given $x$. The distinction is important, as specification uncertainty informs the decision to request clarification before making a prediction. We build approximations of these components and connect them to existing uncertainty measures. Our experiments across different domains and modalities show distinct roles for the three components. Specification uncertainty is the most informative for detecting underspecified inputs, while residual aleatoric uncertainty is the most informative for detecting in-distribution prediction errors.
articles.titleCn: 感知规格预测不确定性分解
articles.abstractCn: 预测不确定性的经典分解，例如基于信息论的方法，是针对输入对象的固定表示 $x$ 定义的。它们并未考虑 $x$ 可能不完整，也未衡量缺失信息对预测可能产生的影响。在大语言模型中，用户可以在无需重新训练的情况下澄清不明确的输入。澄清后的输入能更准确地描述用户未观察到的意图 $z^*$，并改变对结果的预测不确定性。在本文中，我们通过概率方法形式化这一设置，并将预测风险分解为规范不确定性、剩余偶然不确定性和认知不确定性三项。我们证明，在原始信息层级上，当仅 $x$ 可用时，偶然不确定性（以贝叶斯风险表示）包含两个组成部分。第一个，我们称之为规范不确定性，是揭示意图后贝叶斯风险的预期降低量。第二个是剩余偶然不确定性，即意图已知后剩余的贝叶斯风险，在给定 $x$ 时对其可能值 $z$ 的所有可能值进行平均。这一区分很重要，因为规范不确定性指导着在做出预测前是否请求澄清的决策。我们构建了这些组成部分的近似模型，并将它们与现有的不确定性度量方法联系起来。我们的跨领域和跨模态实验表明，这三项具有不同的作用。规范不确定性最有助于检测不明确的输入，而剩余偶然不确定性最有助于检测分布内预测误差。

articles.title: Action Verification through Conjecture and Refutation for Language Model Agents
articles.abstract: Language model agents increasingly act on users' behalf by manipulating external environments through tools, often from high-level instructions that leave critical task- and environment-specific context unstated. To prevent resulting misaligned actions, recent work verifies proposed actions before execution, largely by establishing whether the conditions supporting them hold. We argue that this confirmation-oriented view leaves a fundamental blind spot: a wrong action often passes every check that asks whether it is right. This motivates a different question for verification: rather than asking what evidence supports an action, can the agent find evidence that refutes it? We pursue this direction with BlackSwan, a refutation-oriented, expect-suspect-test procedure that predicts the intended effect of each state-mutating action, formulates specific and empirically testable hypotheses for how it could be wrong, and tests them using existing observations or additional non-mutating actions, executing the action only if none survives testing. On challenging AppWorld tasks, BlackSwan improves success rate over the strongest baseline by 14.9 and 25.2%p with and without the backbone model's thinking mode, respectively. Even without thinking or in-context demonstrations, it outperforms stronger baselines equipped with them. The gains also transfer beyond AppWorld, with BlackSwan improving WebShop performance by 12.7%p. More broadly, our results suggest that language model agents have an underused capacity to recognize and self-correct misaligned actions, which can be systematically elicited through active conjecture and refutation before execution.
articles.titleCn: 基于猜想与反驳的语言模型代理的行为验证
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理越来越多地通过工具操控外部环境来代表用户行动，这些行动通常基于高层指令，而这些指令往往未明确说明关键的任务和环境特定上下文。为了防止由此产生的行动与预期不符，近期研究在执行前验证提议的行动，主要方式是确认支持这些行动的条件是否成立。我们认为这种以确认为导向的观点存在一个根本性的盲点：一个错误的行动往往能通过所有询问其正确性的检查。这促使我们提出一个不同的验证问题：代理能否找到反驳该行动的证据？我们通过BlackSwan来探索这一方向，BlackSwan是一种以反驳为导向、预期-怀疑-测试的程序，它预测每个改变状态的行动的预期效果，针对其可能出错的方式提出具体且可经验检验的假设，并使用现有观察结果或额外的非改变状态行动来测试这些假设，只有在没有任何假设通过测试时才执行该行动。在具有挑战性的AppWorld任务中，BlackSwan在有和无骨干模型的思考模式的情况下，分别比最强的基线提高了14.9%和25.2%的成功率。即使没有思考或在情境中的演示，它也优于配备了这些功能的更强的基线。这些提升也超越了AppWorld，BlackSwan使WebShop的性能提高了12.7%。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明语言模型代理具有未被充分利用的识别和自我纠正与预期不符的行动的能力，这种能力可以通过在执行前通过主动假设和反驳来系统地激发。

articles.title: PlagiaCorpus: A Bilingual, Adversarial, and Cross-Lingual Dataset for Forensic Plagiarism Detection
articles.abstract: PlagiaCorpus is a bilingual Arabic-English dataset for benchmarking plagiarism and text-reuse detection, including reuse produced by large language models (LLMs) and reuse across languages. It contains 198,643 text records: a source corpus of 34,885 passages drawn from English and Arabic Wikipedia and two openly licensed book collections, and 163,758 queries (147,381 for training and 16,377 for testing). The queries cover five reuse classes of increasing difficulty, namely verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, same-language paraphrasing by two different LLMs, and English--Arabic translation with structural paraphrasing, together with a Safe class of non-reused passages. Every positive query is linked to its source passage, and the train/test split is grouped by source passage so that no passage contributes queries to both splits. The release was curated through language identification, removal of LLM generation artefacts, and exact and cross-lingual de-duplication. Technical validation reports per-class length statistics, automatic checks of the train/test split, and inter-annotator agreement on a manually rated sample. The dataset is distributed in JSON and Parquet formats under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license.
articles.titleCn: PlagiaCorpus：一个用于法医剽窃检测的双语、对抗性和跨语言数据集
articles.abstractCn: PlagiaCorpus是一个用于基准测试剽窃和文本重复检测的双语（阿拉伯语-英语）数据集，包括由大型语言模型（LLMs）产生的重复使用以及跨语言的重复使用。它包含198,643条文本记录：一个包含34,885段文本的源语料库，这些文本来自英语和阿拉伯语维基百科以及两个开放许可的书籍集合，以及163,758个查询（147,381个用于训练，16,377个用于测试）。这些查询涵盖了五个难度递增的重复使用类别，即逐字复制、字符级混淆、由两个不同的LLMs进行的同语言释义，以及带有结构释义的英语-阿拉伯语翻译，以及一个未重复使用的Safe类别。每个阳性查询都链接到其源文本，并且训练/测试划分按源文本分组，以确保没有文本同时贡献查询给两个划分。发布过程通过语言识别、移除LLMs生成的人工制品以及精确和跨语言的去重进行筛选。技术验证报告包括按类别长度的统计数据、训练/测试划分的自动检查，以及手动评分样本的标注者间一致性。该数据集在CC BY-SA 4.0许可证下以JSON和Parquet格式分发。

articles.title: A State Change Is Local, Its Consequences Are Not: Dependency-Aware State Revision for Long-Term Agent Memory
articles.abstract: Long-lived agents rely on persistent memory of users, tasks and decisions, and this memory must stay consistent with a world that keeps changing. When an upstream fact changes, however, memory systems can revise the contradicted memory itself while the beliefs, plans and actions derived from it remain accepted, even though they have lost their support. We therefore formulate dependency-aware state revision, which asks not only what changed but also which dependent states should no longer be trusted. To address it, StateGraph maintains an evolving state dependency graph whose edges are recovered from interaction histories. Its core design is counterfactual verification: each candidate edge is tested by asking whether the dependent state would survive the loss of its premise, which separates support dependence from semantic relatedness, and revision then invalidates a dependent state only when a strict dependency fails and no independent support path survives. To test this design, we introduce StateChangeBench, a controlled benchmark of 50 author-constructed cases annotated with cascade depth, hard negatives and action consequences. On it, StateGraph's Impact-F1 margin over a CUPMem reimplementation is 6.9 percentage points at depth 1 and 26.0 at depth 3+. On public long-term memory benchmarks, its point estimates are comparable to or higher than those of the evaluated baselines on most datasets. These results provide initial evidence that explicit dependency tracking can improve selective memory revision under changing conditions.
articles.titleCn: 状态变化是局部的，其影响并非如此：依赖感知的状态修订用于长期智能体记忆
articles.abstractCn: 长寿命智能体依赖于对用户、任务和决策的持久记忆，并且这种记忆必须与不断变化的世界保持一致。然而，当上游事实发生变化时，记忆系统可以修正被反驳的记忆本身，而从中得出的信念、计划和行为仍然被接受，即使它们已经失去了支持。因此，我们提出了依赖感知状态修正，它不仅询问发生了什么变化，还询问哪些依赖状态不再值得信任。为了解决这个问题，StateGraph维护了一个不断演化的状态依赖图，其边从交互历史中恢复。其核心设计是反事实验证：每个候选边都通过询问依赖状态是否能在其前提丢失的情况下存活来进行测试，这区分了支持依赖与语义相关性，并且修正只有在严格依赖失败且没有独立的支撑路径时才会使依赖状态失效。为了测试这一设计，我们引入了StateChangeBench，这是一个由50个作者构建的受控基准，标注了级联深度、困难负例和行动后果。在它上面，StateGraph在深度1时的Impact-F1分数比CUPMem重实现高出6.9个百分点，在深度3+时高出26.0个百分点。在公开的长期记忆基准上，其点估计值在大多数数据集上与评估的基线相当或更高。这些结果初步表明，显式依赖跟踪可以在变化条件下改进选择性记忆修正。

articles.title: User Attributes and Political Ideology Shape LLM Receptiveness in Online Political Debates
articles.abstract: Online political discussions increasingly involve AI-mediated participation, as users invoke LLMs to assess contested claims, arbitrate disputes, and respond to opposing viewpoints. As these systems become participants in online exchanges, they may alter which speakers and argumentative strategies receive validation within the discussion. We study this interactional dimension by reconstructing 5,376 Debate.org debates as LLM conversations and running nearly 150,000 controlled multi-turn conversations that vary user political orientation, expertise, rhetorical strategy, and defended position, including conversations with competing users. Across naturalistic and controlled debates, we find that LLMs are systematically more receptive to left-leaning than right-leaning users. The asymmetry persists when users with different political orientations defend the same position and when opposing users appear in the same conversation, indicating that it is not fully explained by stance agreement or simple accommodation to the current speaker. Repeated interaction increases receptiveness without eliminating this ordering; expertise also matters, while rhetorical differences are smaller. The pattern appears across multiple models, but is not fixed: fine-tuning on different political corpora can largely erase or reverse it. These results show that LLMs can respond systematically differently to participants in the same political debate, making such interactional asymmetries important for understanding their emerging role in online public discourse.
articles.titleCn: 用户属性和政治意识形态塑造了大型语言模型在在线政治辩论中的接受度
articles.abstractCn: 在线政治讨论中，人工智能参与度日益增加，用户借助大型语言模型评估争议性主张、仲裁争端并回应对立观点。随着这些系统成为网络交流的参与者，它们可能改变哪些发言者和论证策略在讨论中获得认可。我们通过将5,376场Debate.org辩论重构为大型语言模型对话，并运行近15万场受控的多轮对话（这些对话的用户政治倾向、专业知识、修辞策略和捍卫立场各不相同，包括与竞争用户的对话）来研究这种互动维度。在自然和受控辩论中，我们发现大型语言模型系统性地对左倾用户比对右倾用户更易接受。当具有不同政治倾向的用户捍卫相同立场或对立用户出现在同一对话中时，这种不对称性依然存在，表明这并非完全由立场一致或对当前发言者的简单迁就所解释。重复互动会增加易接受度但不会消除这种排序；专业知识也很重要，而修辞差异较小。这种模式在多个模型中均有体现，但并非固定不变：在不同政治语料库上进行微调可以很大程度上消除或逆转这种模式。这些结果表明，大型语言模型可以对同一政治辩论中的参与者做出系统性的不同回应，因此理解这种互动不对称性对于理解它们在在线公共话语中的新兴作用至关重要。

articles.title: Maswao: An automatically collected, prepared, and benchmarked dataset for the South African Sign language
articles.abstract: Recent advancements in sign language processing can be attributed to developments in both large-scale dataset collection and algorithmic complexity in areas such as pose estimation techniques, signal processing through Transformer models, and model optimization. However, only a handful of sign languages, such as the American, British, and German, from over 200 globally recognized sign languages, reap the benefits of such advancements, while the rest lag behind. In this study, we aim to address this technological disparity by proposing a framework for the automatic collection and preparation of sign language datasets, with very minimal human-labour intervention, using the South African Sign Language (SASL) as a testbed. Specifically, we automatically collect SASL video content using public resources such as news broadcasts. Additionally, we convert their accompanying audio streams into text using available Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) tools. Furthermore, we crop the sign language area in the videos and use gradient descent to locate valleys of non-motion to determine end-of-sentence points within long videos to create our weakly sentence-aligned parallel corpora -- the Maswao (Signs) dataset. Finally, we benchmark the weakly aligned dataset on the task of Sign-to-text Translation using Recurrent Neural Networks and Transformer models to compare their individual intricacies. Our results show that Transformer models proposed in the literature outperform recurrent baselines, with the best-performing Transformer achieving BLEU-1 to BLEU-4 scores of 13.78, 5.21, 2.52, and 1.54, respectively, as well as ChrF = 18.09 and ROUGE-L = 10.51. These results indicate that the task remains promising and warrants further investigations.
articles.titleCn: Maswao：一个用于南非手语的自动收集、准备和基准数据集
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，手语处理技术的进步可归因于大规模数据集收集和算法复杂性的发展，特别是在姿态估计技术、通过Transformer模型进行的信号处理以及模型优化等领域。然而，在全球200多种被认可的手语中，只有少数几种，如美国手语、英国手语和德国手语，受益于这些进步，而其余的手语则落后。在本研究中，我们旨在通过提出一个自动收集和准备手语数据集的框架来解决这个问题，该框架使用南非手语（SASL）作为测试平台，并尽量减少人工干预。具体而言，我们使用公共资源（如新闻广播）自动收集SASL视频内容。此外，我们使用可用的自动语音识别（ASR）工具将视频中的音频流转换为文本。然后，我们从视频中裁剪出手语区域，并使用梯度下降法定位非运动区域的山谷，以确定长视频中的句子结束点，从而创建我们的弱对齐平行语料库——Maswao（手语）数据集。最后，我们使用循环神经网络和Transformer模型对手语到文本翻译任务上的弱对齐数据集进行基准测试，以比较它们的各自复杂性。我们的结果表明，文献中提出的Transformer模型优于循环基线模型，其中表现最佳的Transformer模型实现了BLEU-1至BLEU-4分数分别为13.78、5.21、2.52和1.54，以及ChrF = 18.09和ROUGE-L = 10.51。这些结果表明该任务仍然具有前景，值得进一步研究。

articles.title: Tug of Watts: A study on the Energy - Accuracy Trade-off of Large Language Models on Medical Question Answering Tasks
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical question answering (QA) systems. While recent works aim at incrementally improving the downstream task accuracy, an empirical estimation of the models' energy consumption and the associated carbon footprints is often overlooked. In this study, we demonstrate how practitioners can estimate energy consumption and arrive at reliable emission estimates for medical QA tasks available in the OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard by investigating 13 LLMs from 3 model families ranging from 270M to 14B parameters. We discuss how one can critically interpret energy versus accuracy trade-offs for a set of models for a given task. With this work, we underline that reporting disjoint energy and accuracy metrics alone does not suffice for careful trade-off assessments, but it also demands systematic construction and interpretation of joint trade-off metrics. We envisage such studies aiding practitioners in adopting better and more efficient models for their task and helping them become active participants in building sustainable LLM pipelines.
articles.comment: Accepted to "Workshop on GREEN-AI: Grounding Research on Energy- and resource-Efficient Networks for sustainable AI", Co-Located with CIKM 2026, November 08, 2026, Rome, Italy
articles.titleCn: 拔河瓦特：一项关于大型语言模型在医学问答任务中能量-精度权衡的研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医疗问答（QA）系统中应用日益广泛。尽管近期研究致力于逐步提升下游任务的准确性，但模型能耗的实证评估及其相关的碳足迹往往被忽视。本研究通过分析3个模型家族中13个参数规模从270M到14B不等的大型语言模型，展示了从业者如何评估能耗并得出OpenMedical-LLM排行榜上医疗QA任务的可靠排放估计。我们探讨了如何对特定任务下模型的能耗与准确性权衡进行批判性解读。通过这项工作，我们强调仅报告独立的能耗和准确性指标不足以进行审慎的权衡评估，同时也需要系统性地构建和解读联合权衡指标。我们期望此类研究能帮助从业者选择更适合其任务的高效模型，并促使他们成为构建可持续LLM流程的积极参与者。

articles.title: Omni-Life: Benchmarking Omnimodal Real-Time AI Assistants in People's Daily Lives
articles.abstract: Real-time omnimodal assistants are expected to support people in everyday life, but audiovisual understanding alone does not establish whether they can provide timely and appropriate help. We introduce Omni-Life, a benchmark grounded in real-world user needs, deployment scenarios, and device-dependent observations. It combines controlled video synthesis for hazardous situations and edge cases with annotated real-world videos under a shared temporal protocol. The benchmark contains 400 videos: 290 requiring assistance, with 555 required intervention events, and 110 requiring silence throughout to test whether models can withhold unnecessary responses when no assistance is needed. We evaluate twelve configurations featuring mainstream real-time omnimodal models, jointly assessing event coverage, response content, timing, and unwanted output. At most 4.48% of videos requiring assistance are handled completely correctly. To examine practical deployment strategies, we study task reminders and response-latency tolerance. Reminders can improve recall by 17.12 percentage points but add approximately 4.6 unwanted responses per minute of reference silence. Increasing latency tolerance by 10s improves recall by at most 5.95 percentage points. These results show that existing models remain insufficient to deliver reliable assistance in real-life applications, calling for tailored model optimization in instruction following, timely proactive intervention, and withholding responses when assistance is not needed.
articles.titleCn: Omni-Life：在人们日常生活中对多模态实时AI助手进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 实时全模态助手有望支持人们的日常生活，但仅靠视听理解并不能确定它们能否提供及时且恰当的帮助。我们介绍了Omni-Life，这是一个基于真实用户需求、部署场景和设备相关观察的基准。它结合了受控的危险情况和边缘案例视频合成，以及遵循相同时间协议的标注真实世界视频。该基准包含400个视频：290个需要帮助，涉及555个需要干预的事件，以及110个需要全程保持沉默以测试模型在不需要帮助时能否抑制不必要响应。我们评估了十二种主流实时全模态模型的配置，综合评估事件覆盖范围、响应内容、时机和不受欢迎的输出。最多只有4.48%需要帮助的视频被完全正确处理。为了研究实际部署策略，我们研究了任务提醒和响应延迟容忍度。提醒可以提高召回率17.12个百分点，但每分钟参考沉默时间会额外增加约4.6个不受欢迎的响应。将延迟容忍度增加10秒最多可以提高召回率5.95个百分点。这些结果表明，现有模型在现实应用中仍不足以提供可靠帮助，需要针对指令遵循、及时主动干预以及在不需要帮助时抑制响应进行定制化模型优化。

articles.title: Window-Aware Scheduling for Health Messaging under Platform Delivery Constraints: Evidence from an AI-Powered WhatsApp Maternal and Infant Health Chatbot in Nigeria
articles.abstract: WhatsApp lets a business send free-form messages only within 24 hours of a user's last message; outside this customer service window, only pre-approved templates are delivered. Health chatbots inherit this rule, but its cost is rarely measured. We analyse 98,607 messages sent to 3,696 mothers by a WhatsApp maternal health chatbot in Nigeria, with a largely separate export as replication. No free-form message failed with the window open (0 of 35,500), and failure jumped by 93.0 percentage points (95% CI 87.0 to 99.1) at exactly 24 hours. Two flows produced 66.1% of failures, including an offer to speak with a medical professional that, as built, reached 0.3 in 100 mothers whose window had closed. We formalise window-aware scheduling as a decision problem with an action of known zero value. Model-based offline evaluation, with bounds for unconfirmed delivery, estimates that sending the offer as an approved template would reach 81.5 to 86.8 in 100 such mothers, against 16.6 for waiting and 11.6 for a reply prompt. In a calibrated simulation, tabular Q-learning converges to the same template rule and does not beat it in any of 13 stress tests, and opting out does not rise with message volume. The main gain comes from respecting the platform rule, and it needs no learning. All outcomes are deliveries, not health outcomes.
articles.titleCn: 平台交付约束下的健康信息窗口感知调度：尼日利亚人工智能赋能的WhatsApp母婴健康聊天机器人证据
articles.abstractCn: WhatsApp允许企业仅在用户最后一条消息后的24小时内发送自由格式消息；在此客户服务窗口之外，仅发送预先批准的模板。健康聊天机器人继承了这一规则，但其成本很少被衡量。我们分析了尼日利亚一个WhatsApp母婴健康聊天机器人向3,696位母亲发送的98,607条消息，并进行了大规模的独立出口作为复制验证。当窗口开启时，没有自由格式消息失败（0/35,500），但在正好24小时时，失败率跃升至93.0个百分点（95%置信区间为87.0至99.1）。其中两种流程产生了66.1%的失败，包括提供与医疗专业人员交谈的选项，按照现有设计，在窗口关闭的母亲中，该选项仅触达了0.3%。我们将窗口感知调度形式化为一个具有已知零价值动作的决策问题。基于模型的离线评估，考虑到未确认交付的界限，估计将此选项作为批准模板发送，将触达100位此类母亲的81.5至86.8人，而等待的触达率为16.6，回复提示的触达率为11.6。在一个校准模拟中，表格Q学习收敛到相同的模板规则，并在13项压力测试中均未超越该规则，且选择退出与消息量无关。主要收益来自于遵守平台规则，且无需学习。所有结果均为交付，而非健康结果。

articles.title: TRIO: Task Refinement with Individual Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: This paper studies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which leverages external knowledge to improve the performance of language models. Despite the remarkable progress, current RAG approaches are still far from satisfactory due to inadequate retrieval and potential hallucinations. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Task Refinement with Individual Optimization (TRIO) for RAG. The core idea of our TRIO is to equip three well-designed agents with an iterative refinement paradigm by aligning their individual optimization objectives. Specifically, we first expand ambiguous queries with a query extension agent and quantify the reward based on the improved answer quality, which can be utilized to refine our agent for higher expansion efficiency. To enhance the retrieval quality, we include a unanimity voting to annotate the expanded query as insufficient or sufficient, and their generative outcomes are utilized as ground truth to optimize the judge agent. To further improve evidence utilization and answer accuracy, an answer agent is optimized with dynamic matching-based rewards with curriculum learning for final outputs. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed TRIO in comparison with state-of-the-art approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingtaoren/TRIO.

articles.titleCn: TRIO：针对检索增强生成的个体优化任务细化
articles.abstractCn: 本文研究了检索增强生成（RAG），该方法利用外部知识来提升语言模型的表现。尽管取得了显著进展，但当前的RAG方法仍因检索不足和潜在幻觉而远未达到令人满意的程度。为此，我们提出了一种名为任务细化与个体优化（TRIO）的新型RAG方法。TRIO的核心思想是通过协调三个精心设计的代理的个体优化目标，赋予它们迭代细化范式。具体而言，我们首先使用查询扩展代理扩展模糊查询，并根据改进的答案质量量化奖励，这可用于优化代理以实现更高的扩展效率。为提升检索质量，我们引入了一致性投票来标注扩展后的查询为不足或充分，并利用其生成结果作为真实标签来优化判断代理。为进一步改进证据利用和答案准确性，我们使用基于动态匹配的奖励和课程学习的答案代理来优化最终输出。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了所提出的TRIO与最先进方法相比的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/yingtaoren/TRIO获取。

articles.title: Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation
articles.abstract: Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works internally, with shared indicators of four properties: player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness. We implement three contrasting managers, based respectively on open generation, Monte Carlo repair, and autonomous characters, and compare them through functional analysis on an interactive Little Red Riding Hood scenario. The results show that no manager dominates on every property, giving authors and EM designers a concrete basis to select a manager according to their priorities.
articles.titleCn: 使用大型语言模型创建混合交互式叙事系统：从形式化描述到评估
articles.abstractCn: 交互式叙事允许用户塑造故事，而体验管理器（EM）则保持其连贯性，在玩家自由与作者控制之间取得平衡。大型语言模型现在催生了一代混合式EM，它们结合了从自由文本输入的运行时生成与符号化叙事控制。然而，它们的异构性使得比较变得困难：管理器的行为通常与其运行的独特且特定的场景相关联，其大部分决策过程都在任何明确且可验证的结构之外进行。我们通过一个基于LLM的叙事平台来解决这个问题，其管理器是可互换的模块，在共享的符号化世界模型（包含事实、操作和目标）上运行。由于每个应用的操作都带有明确的先决条件和效果，因此每个会话都可以通过一个通用的状态转换表示被分析为计划，并使用共享的四个属性指标（玩家能动性、EM可控性、作者意图和鲁棒性）进行评估，而与管理者内部的工作方式无关。我们实现了三个对比鲜明的管理器，分别基于开放生成、蒙特卡洛修复和自主角色，并通过在交互式小红帽场景中进行功能分析来比较它们。结果表明，没有哪个管理器在所有属性上都占优，为作者和EM设计者提供了一个具体的基础，让他们可以根据自己的优先级选择管理器。

articles.title: SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents
articles.abstract: Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen scenarios.However, existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. We instantiated the tasks on games for controllability and reproducibility, and pairs them with scalable generation and orchestration driven by task templates and difficulty coefficients. Beyond task-level scores, SelfImprove-Bench organizes evaluation into generalization ladder levels G0 to G4 that measure how far gains transfer from training conditions. Experiments reveal that the evolutionary gains of existing RSI methods are inconsistent across generalization levels.
articles.titleCn: 自我提升基准：评估自我提升智能体的泛化能力
articles.abstractCn: 递归自改进（RSI）系统正日益被视为加速迈向通用人工智能（AGI）进程的一种有前景的方法。它们旨在通过优化其工作流程并递归地改进指导后续优化的策略，从而自主提升其能力，且这些提升能够泛化到未见过的场景中。然而，现有的评估缺乏可靠的指标来区分能力提升与场景拟合，缺乏可持续和可扩展的未见任务与困难的协议，以及将改进细粒度归因于进化轨迹的方法。为此，我们提出了SelfImprove-Bench，这是一个RSI评估框架，它将任务组织为三个主要能力（即探索、规划、推理）作为指导模型进化的场景。我们在游戏中实例化了这些任务，以实现可控性和可重复性，并将它们与由任务模板和难度系数驱动的可扩展生成和协调机制相匹配。除了任务级评分外，SelfImprove-Bench将评估组织为从G0到G4的泛化阶梯级别，以衡量收益从训练条件转移的程度。实验表明，现有RSI方法的进化收益在不同泛化级别上存在不一致性。

articles.title: PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring from an external serving dependency into an integrated capability of the backbone model. PGuard directly leverages the backbone's intermediate representations for token-level safety detection, without altering its original inference pathway or generation behavior. Specifically, dynamic layer gating selectively aggregates residual-stream representations across layers to extract safety-relevant signals during both prefill and autoregressive decoding. To balance detection accuracy and computational efficiency, PGuard supports multiple representation-modeling architectures, including a lightweight stateless variant and sequence-aware variants built on multi-scale causal EMA-attention and GRU-based recurrent modules. Its design also accounts for the execution characteristics of LLM serving frameworks, such as SGLang, optimizing computation and data access to minimize additional runtime and synchronization overhead. As a result, PGuard incurs only 0.82-2.26% end-to-end overhead on the hundred-billion-parameter backbone Qwen3.5-122B-A10B served by SGLang. Extensive evaluations across more than 30 benchmarks spanning text and multimodal safety, jailbreaks, cyber and CBRN risks, multilingual scenarios, and real-world traffic demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among native guardrails. On text queries with Qwen3.5-9B, PGuard achieves an average F1 score of 0.836, approaching dedicated external guardrails, while supporting deployment-time configuration of category-specific thresholds and enforcement actions.
articles.titleCn: PGuard：一种面向多模态大型语言模型的本地、流式和插件式护栏
articles.abstractCn: 随着流式生成成为文本仅和多模态大型语言模型的主导服务范式，确保整个生成过程中的安全性已成为一项关键挑战。我们介绍了PGuard，一种原生的、流式的插件式护栏，它将安全监控从外部服务依赖转变为骨干模型集成功能。PGuard直接利用骨干模型的中间表示进行token级安全检测，而不会改变其原始推理路径或生成行为。具体而言，动态层门控会跨层选择性地聚合残差流表示，在预填充和自回归解码期间提取与安全相关的信号。为了平衡检测精度和计算效率，PGuard支持多种表示建模架构，包括轻量级无状态变体以及基于多尺度因果EMA-注意力和基于GRU的循环模块构建的序列感知变体。其设计还考虑了LLM服务框架（如SGLang）的执行特性，优化计算和数据访问以最小化额外的运行时和同步开销。因此，在由SGLang服务的千亿参数骨干Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上，PGuard仅产生0.82-2.26%的端到端开销。在涵盖文本和多模态安全、越狱、网络和CBRN风险、多语言场景和真实流量等超过30个基准测试中的广泛评估表明，在原生护栏中，PGuard实现了最先进的性能。在Qwen3.5-9B的文本查询中，PGuard实现了平均F1分数0.836，接近专用外部护栏，同时支持部署时配置特定类别的阈值和执行动作。

articles.title: Stop Handcrafting Your Engine! GenDB-V: Towards AI-Generated and Formally Verified Database Systems
articles.abstract: For over 50 years, the database community has developed a wide range of successful engines to answer two fundamental questions: how can database systems run faster, and how can we ensure their correctness? Experience with these engines shows that performance depends on hardware and workloads. As both change over time, we repeatedly redesign and rebuild database systems, a time-consuming and expensive process. Correctness remains another long-standing challenge: recent studies continue to uncover wrong-answer bugs even in mature database engines, despite years of development and testing. To address these, we present GenDB-V, a system that enables AI agents to synthesize database engines specialized to hardware and workloads for performance, and formally verified for correctness. GenDB-V supports specialized implementations of SQL templates and general-purpose engines that accept any query within a supported SQL subset. First, we develop SQLSpec to formalize SQL semantics and deterministically construct fixed, implementation-agnostic synthesis targets. Second, we enable joint synthesis of fast code and formal proofs through storage--execution co-optimization, performance-first exploration, and three-layer modular proofs that bridge low-level execution to SQLSpec semantics. Third, we verify the synthesized code and proofs against the fixed synthesis targets in an isolated pipeline, proving SQL correctness and program safety. We evaluate GenDB-V on TPC-H and SEC-EDGAR. For verified template implementations, GenDB-V achieves geometric-mean speedups of 22.0-61.3x over DuckDB and Umbra. For a verified general-purpose engine, GenDB-V also achieves speedups of 1.27-3.4x on TPC-H. GenDB-V also achieves better performance than a testing-based LLM synthesis method, while our audit and tests expose incorrect answers in that method's implementations for 16 of 28 templates.
articles.titleCn: 停止手工打造您的引擎！GenDB-V：迈向人工智能生成和形式化验证的数据库系统
articles.abstractCn: 超过50年来，数据库领域发展了多种成功的引擎，以回答两个基本问题：如何使数据库系统运行更快，以及如何确保其正确性。这些引擎的经验表明，性能取决于硬件和工作负载。随着硬件和工作负载的不断变化，我们反复重新设计和构建数据库系统，这是一个耗时且昂贵的过程。正确性仍然是另一个长期存在的挑战：尽管经过多年的开发和测试，最近的研究仍然在成熟的数据库引擎中发现错误答案的漏洞。为了应对这些问题，我们提出了GenDB-V系统，该系统使AI代理能够合成针对硬件和工作负载进行优化的数据库引擎，并对其进行形式化验证以确保正确性。GenDB-V支持SQL模板的专用实现和通用引擎，后者可以接受任何支持的SQL子集中的查询。首先，我们开发了SQLSpec来形式化SQL语义，并确定性地构建固定、与实现无关的合成目标。其次，我们通过存储-执行协同优化、以性能优先的探索和三层模块化证明，实现了快速代码和形式化证明的联合合成，将低级执行与SQLSpec语义连接起来。第三，我们在隔离的管道中验证合成的代码和证明，以固定的合成目标证明SQL正确性和程序安全性。我们在TPC-H和SEC-EDGAR上评估了GenDB-V。对于经过验证的模板实现，GenDB-V比DuckDB和Umbra实现了22.0-61.3倍的几何平均加速。对于经过验证的通用引擎，GenDB-V在TPC-H上也实现了1.27-3.4倍的加速。GenDB-V还比基于测试的LLM合成方法实现了更好的性能，而我们的审计和测试在该方法的28个模板中有16个模板的实施中暴露了错误答案。

articles.title: EffComp: Efficient Prompt Compression via Hybrid Reinforcement & Supervised Learning
articles.abstract: Prompt compression is aimed at reducing input prompt lengths to enable cheaper, faster, and potentially higher-quality LLM predictions. However, existing prompt compression methods are often limited by modest compression gains, a risk of hallucination, and/or high compression latency. We propose EffComp, an Efficient prompt Compression framework for RAG-based question answering (QA). EffComp employs BERT-style document reranker and sentence selector models to allow fast extractive prompt compression at the sentence level. Its extractive nature prevents hallucinations in the compressed prompts. Additionally, the training process using a hybrid reinforcement and supervised learning approach is designed to optimize the compression ratio while preserving LLM accuracy. Experiments on various QA datasets demonstrate that EffComp outperforms state-of-the-art prompt compression methods achieving the best trade-off between compression ratio and accuracy with minimal latency. This makes it practical for real-world applications.
articles.titleCn: EffComp：混合强化学习与监督学习的高效提示压缩
articles.abstractCn: 提示压缩旨在缩短输入提示的长度，以实现更经济、更快、且潜在质量更高的LLM预测。然而，现有的提示压缩方法通常受限于压缩增益有限、存在幻觉风险以及/或压缩延迟高的问题。我们提出了EffComp，一个用于基于RAG的问答（QA）的高效提示压缩框架。EffComp采用BERT风格的文档重排序和句子选择模型，以实现句子级别的快速抽取式提示压缩。其抽取特性可防止压缩提示中的幻觉。此外，采用混合强化学习和监督学习方法的训练过程旨在优化压缩率，同时保持LLM的准确性。在多个QA数据集上的实验表明，EffComp优于最先进的提示压缩方法，在压缩率和准确性之间实现了最佳平衡，且延迟最小。这使得它在实际应用中具有可行性。

articles.title: Replay for LLM Continual Learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills domain experts into one student but needs every expert at once. When domains arrive one at a time and earlier experts are gone, the previous-stage student can teach replayed prompts of earlier domains inside every stage. Some pipelines instead store every stage snapshot for a final multi-teacher recovery stage. On five domains with a 1.5B student and five public experts, this paper compares both with joint MOPD. It varies the replay budget and the replay signal. The signal is token-level distillation alone or with alignment of hidden states, attention and value relations. Sequential distillation without replay or recovery is 6.2 points below 208-step joint MOPD on a 14-benchmark average and 3.5 points below on the 11 benchmarks outside safety. Without snapshots, replay toward the previous student closes 3.8 of the 6.2 points when the earlier domains share the replay budget of a stage. With a fixed share of seven replay steps per earlier domain and stage, it closes 5.8 over two training runs. This is level with the 5.9 of recovery from all snapshots, both at its default length and when given as many training steps as the fixed share. Alignment terms on replay steps change the average by about one point or less. If refusal and compliance count equally in safety, shared-budget replay ranks first among the trained configurations, and the fixed share stays at or above recovery. Against the shared budget, the fixed share lowers the score on the newest domain. Recovery lowers this score as well, in five of six cases. The replay steps of the fixed share grow quadratically with the number of stages.
articles.titleCn: 用于LLM持续学习的多教师在线策略蒸馏回放
articles.abstractCn: 多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）将领域专家蒸馏成一个学生，但需要同时使用所有专家。当领域逐个到达且早期专家已经消失时，前一阶段的学生可以在每个阶段内部教授早期领域的重放提示。有些流程则存储每个阶段的快照，用于最终的多元教师恢复阶段。本文在五个领域、一个15亿参数的学生和五个公共专家上，将这两种方法与联合MOPD进行了比较。它改变了重放预算和重放信号。信号是仅限于token级别的蒸馏，或者结合隐藏状态、注意力值和关系对齐。无重放或恢复的顺序蒸馏，在14个基准测试的平均值上比208步联合MOPD低6.2分，在11个非安全基准测试上低3.5分。没有快照时，向前一阶段学生的重放弥补了6.2分中的3.8分，当早期领域共享一个阶段的重放预算时。以每个早期领域和阶段固定分配七个重放步骤，在两次训练运行中弥补了5.8分。这等于从所有快照恢复的5.9分，无论其默认长度还是分配与固定份额相同数量的训练步骤。重放步骤的对齐项使平均分变化约1分或更少。如果安全和拒绝计数相等，共享预算重放在所有训练配置中排名第一，固定份额保持在或高于恢复水平。与共享预算相比，固定份额降低了最新领域上的分数，恢复在六分之五的情况下也降低了该分数。固定份额的重放步骤随着阶段数量的增加呈二次方增长。

articles.title: MicroMouse: Masking Harmful Supervision in Long CoT via Relative Potential
articles.abstract: Even successful long CoTs may contain harmful supervision, motivating the need for methods that can automatically identify and mask such signals during SFT. Inspired by the MicroMouse maze-solving process, we view a long CoT as a search trajectory from the input problem toward the target answer. This perspective motivates maintaining a goal-relative measure, analogous to a MicroMouse's spatial coordinates, to quantify how close the current reasoning state is to the target answer. Building on this perspective, we propose MicroMouse, an automated selective-SFT framework for masking harmful supervision in long CoTs. In MicroMouse we introduce a Relative Potential (REP) to measure how closely each reasoning state supports the gold answer. Unlike the perplexity of the gold answer alone, REP measures relative support by contrasting the gold answer with a matched foil. This contrast cancels likelihood variations shared by the pair, yielding a more stable signal of progress toward the target answer. By tracking the REP trajectory, MicroMouse identifies consecutive potential decreases as erroneous exploration and post-peak reasoning as redundant wandering, and masks these harmful supervision during SFT. Extensive experiments across multiple student model scales and reasoning benchmarks show that MicroMouse consistently outperforms Full-CoT SFT and existing selective-SFT baselines, yielding average relative gains of 5.5% in greedy accuracy and 2.6% in Pass@1 relative to Full-CoT SFT. Meanwhile, MicroMouse improves reasoning efficiency by reducing average output length by 8.8%, while identifying harmful supervision in only 1.7 seconds per long CoT on average.
articles.titleCn: 微鼠：通过相对势能遮蔽长CoT中的有害监督
articles.abstractCn: 即使是成功的长链推理（CoT）也可能包含有害的监督信息，这促使我们需要能够自动识别并在监督微调（SFT）过程中屏蔽此类信号的方法。受MicroMouse迷宫求解过程的启发，我们将长链推理视为从输入问题到目标答案的搜索轨迹。这一视角促使我们维护一个目标相对度量，类似于MicroMouse的空间坐标，以量化当前推理状态与目标答案的接近程度。基于这一视角，我们提出了MicroMouse，一个用于屏蔽长链推理中有害监督的自动化选择性-SFT框架。在MicroMouse中，我们引入了相对潜力（REP）来衡量每个推理状态对标准答案的支持程度。与仅计算标准答案的困惑度不同，REP通过与匹配的干扰项进行对比来衡量相对支持。这种对比消除了成对项共有的似然度变化，从而产生一个更稳定的向目标答案进展的信号。通过跟踪REP轨迹，MicroMouse将连续的潜力下降识别为错误的探索，将峰值后的推理识别为冗余的徘徊，并在SFT过程中屏蔽这些有害的监督信息。在多个学生模型规模和推理基准上的大量实验表明，MicroMouse始终优于全链推理SFT和现有的选择性-SFT基线，在贪婪准确率上平均提升了5.5%，在Pass@1指标上平均提升了2.6%。同时，MicroMouse通过将平均输出长度减少8.8%来提高推理效率，同时在平均每个长链推理中仅用1.7秒识别有害监督。

articles.title: LLMs Cannot Be Neutral: Gender Sensitivity Across Candidates, Evaluators, and Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate candidates for professional roles, raising concerns about their sensitivity to demographic identities. We examine how candidate and evaluator gender assignments affect decisions by LLM-as-a-Judge (LaJ) models and decision language models (DLMs). In a hypothetical city council voting task, eight models evaluated 240 synthetic professional narratives from NVIDIA's US and French Nemotron-Personas datasets under independently varied gender assignments, producing 30,720 judgments. Explicit candidate gender labels increased Yes-vote probability by 1.05-1.73 percentage points relative to unspecified gender, while only the nonbinary evaluator assignment showed a significant increase (1.26 points). Identity matching showed no significant overall association. Yes-vote rates varied across models (81.3-97.2%), and 2.5-3.3% of decisions reversed relative to the unspecified-identity baseline. Under direct substitutions between explicit gender identities, DLMs exhibited fewer decision reversals than LaJ models (1.18% vs. 3.38%), indicating lower observed decision-level gender sensitivity among the tested DLMs. These findings demonstrate that gender sensitivity depends on candidate and evaluator identities and the evaluation model, while highlighting the importance of examining individual decision consistency alongside aggregate differences.

articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型无法保持中立：候选者、评估者和模型中的性别敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于评估专业职位的候选人，引发了对其对人口统计身份敏感性的担忧。我们考察了候选人和评估者的性别分配如何影响LLM作为法官（LaJ）模型和决策语言模型（DLM）的决策。在一个假设的城市议会投票任务中，八个模型在独立变化的性别分配下，评估了来自NVIDIA的美国和法国Nemotron-Personas数据集的240个合成专业叙事，产生了30,720个判断。明确的候选人性别标签相对于未指明性别增加了1.05-1.73个百分点，而只有非二元评估者分配显示出显著增加（1.26个百分点）。身份匹配显示出没有显著的整体关联。不同模型的“是”票率有所不同（81.3-97.2%），相对于未指明身份基线，2.5-3.3%的决策发生了逆转。在明确的性别身份之间进行直接替换时，DLM比LaJ模型表现出更少的决策逆转（1.18% vs. 3.38%），表明在测试的DLM中观察到的决策级性别敏感性较低。这些发现表明，性别敏感性取决于候选人和评估者的身份以及评估模型，同时强调了在考察总体差异的同时检查个体决策一致性的重要性。

articles.title: Train the Sampler You Run: Few-Step Masked Diffusion Language Models via Mixture-Likelihood Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: When a masked diffusion language model is sampled in a few parallel steps in a random order, the model actually run is a mixture over reveal plans, while cross-entropy training fits token conditionals rather than this mixture. We introduce mixture-likelihood fine-tuning (Mix-FT), which fine-tunes a pretrained model on an importance-weighted bound of its own sampler's likelihood, with no teacher and no change to the architecture or the sampler. On LLaDA-8B, a LoRA fine-tune for 0.002% of the pretraining compute writes better OpenWebText continuations than continued cross-entropy and Alpha diffusion given the same compute, at every tested step count. With half the model evaluations, 16 rather than 32 steps per block, its continuations score better than the original model's in every seed under three judges, with confidence-based decoding as well as random order, and under confidence-based decoding two blinded LLM raters from different model families prefer them in 69 and 71% of pairs. On a public 110M-parameter block diffusion model, Mix-FT takes under four T4-hours and beats continued cross-entropy, Alpha diffusion and SDTT distillation at 4, 8 and 16 steps per block, under two judges in every seed. Exact likelihoods on text8, with a control that weights every plan equally, attribute about three quarters of the likelihood gain over continued cross-entropy to weighting each plan by how well it explains the sequence.
articles.titleCn: 训练您运行的采样器：基于混合似然微调的少步掩码扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 当对掩码扩散语言模型进行少量并行步骤的随机顺序采样时，实际运行的模型是揭示计划混合体，而交叉熵训练拟合的是标记条件而非这种混合体。我们引入了混合似然微调（Mix-FT），该方法在自身采样器的似然的重要性加权界限上微调预训练模型，无需教师，且不改变架构或采样器。在LLaDA-8B上，对预训练计算0.002%的LoRA微调，在相同计算量下，生成的OpenWebText续写比持续交叉熵和Alpha扩散效果更好，在每个测试的步数下均如此。使用一半的模型评估，即每个块16步而非32步，其续写在不同种子下均优于原始模型，采用基于置信度的解码以及随机顺序，在基于置信度的解码下，来自不同模型系列的两位盲评LLM评分员在69%和71%的对局中更偏好它们。在一个110M参数的公共块扩散模型上，Mix-FT耗时不到四T4小时，在每块4、8和16步的情况下，优于持续交叉熵、Alpha扩散和SDTT蒸馏，在每个种子下由两位评委评判。在text8上的精确似然，带有平等权重每个计划的对照组，将比持续交叉熵高约四分之三的似然增益归因于根据其解释序列的优劣来加权每个计划。

articles.title: Constructing an Artworld Influencers Network by Mining Social Media
articles.abstract: The author shows a methodology for constructing a network map of the artworld. The tweets posted by a manually comprised set of exemplar artworld actors and Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods are used to identify significant artworld actors, including those that do not own a Twitter account. Identified artworld actors form communities detected with the Louvain method, and their authority is evaluated with the HITS centrality method. The resulting artworld network exhibits the ability, starting with a small set of exemplar actors, to identify new artworld actors and provides a wealth of data that would be very hard to collect otherwise.

articles.titleCn: 通过挖掘社交媒体构建艺术界影响者网络
articles.abstractCn: 作者展示了一种构建艺术界网络地图的方法。通过手动组成的一组艺术界典型行动者的推文以及自然语言处理（NLP）方法，识别出重要的艺术界行动者，包括那些没有拥有推特账号的行动者。识别出的艺术界行动者通过Louvain方法检测形成社群，并使用HITS中心性方法评估其权威性。最终形成的艺术界网络展示了从一小部分典型行动者开始识别新艺术界行动者的能力，并提供了一大批其他方式很难收集的数据。

articles.title: Variable names provide priors: semantic grounding enables data-efficient numerical prediction by large language models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, from question answering to code generation. Recent studies have found that LLMs can perform numerical prediction on tabular datasets via in-context learning. However, it remains unclear under what conditions and how LLMs use variable names and in-context examples for numerical prediction. Here we show that semantic grounding, the match between variable names and the values they describe, allows five LLMs without task-specific training to match or outperform seven supervised machine learning (ML) models across 20 datasets from nine scientific domains, particularly when examples are scarce. Reasoning traces indicate that variable names allow LLMs to draw on domain-specific knowledge acquired during pretraining. Using controlled tasks based on physical formulas, we further show that LLMs integrate domain-specific knowledge with in-context examples in a way consistent with Bayesian updating. Specifically, when the relationship between the inputs and the target cannot be inferred from the examples alone, LLMs rely on domain-specific knowledge as the prior. Conversely, as contradicting examples accumulate, LLM predictions shift progressively towards these examples, which act as the likelihood. Our work reveals how LLMs use domain-specific knowledge in numerical prediction and positions them as data-efficient predictors for data-scarce scientific domains.
