articles.titleCn: 变量名提供先验：语义接地使大型语言模型实现数据高效的数值预测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多种任务中表现出色，从问答到代码生成。近期研究表明，LLMs可以通过情境学习对表格数据进行数值预测。然而，LLMs在何种条件下以及如何使用变量名和情境示例进行数值预测仍不明确。我们展示了语义接地——即变量名与其描述值之间的匹配——使得五个未经特定任务训练的LLMs在九个科学领域的20个数据集上，能够匹配或超越七个监督机器学习（ML）模型，尤其是在示例稀缺时。推理轨迹表明，变量名使LLMs能够利用在预训练期间获得的特定领域知识。通过基于物理公式的受控任务，我们进一步表明，LLMs以与贝叶斯更新一致的方式将特定领域知识与情境示例相结合。具体而言，当输入与目标之间的关系仅从示例中无法推断时，LLMs依赖特定领域知识作为先验。相反，随着矛盾示例的积累，LLMs的预测逐渐倾向于这些示例，它们充当似然。我们的工作揭示了LLMs如何在数值预测中使用特定领域知识，并将它们定位为数据高效的预测器，适用于数据稀缺的科学领域。

articles.title: SYNC: A Training-Free Inference Controller for Dynamic Layer Selection in Multi-Persona Alignment
articles.abstract: Steering vectors align a model at inference time without touching its weights, but eliciting several personas at once is a different problem from eliciting one. Prior multi-persona steering approaches predetermine both how persona vectors are combined and the specific layers at which they are injected. Moreover, this static commitment introduces substantial offline search costs to identify suitable target layers, despite the fact that optimal intervention strengths vary dynamically across both decoding steps and distinct personas. We introduce SYNC (SensitivitY-guided iNference Control), a novel training-free inference control framework compatible with pre-existing steering vectors. SYNC dynamically estimates each layer's sensitivity to every persona via cosine similarity trajectories, assigning each persona to its optimal injection layer at every decoding step. Across two models, two persona profiles and steering vectors from both unsupervised and supervised extraction, SYNC leads on 21 of 28 persona configurations, significantly on 15. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/yosefnuragaw/sync}{this https URL}.
articles.titleCn: SYNC：一种用于多角色对齐中动态层选择的免训练推理控制器
articles.abstractCn: 导引向量可以在推理时对模型进行对齐而不触及其权重，但同时引出多个角色与单独引出一个角色是不同的问题。先前的多角色导引方法预先确定角色向量如何组合以及它们注入的具体层。此外，这种静态承诺引入了大量的离线搜索成本，以识别合适的靶层，尽管最佳干预强度在解码步骤和不同角色之间动态变化。我们引入SYNC（SensititY-guided iNference Control，敏感性引导推理控制），这是一个无需训练的推理控制框架，兼容现有的导引向量。SYNC通过余弦相似度轨迹动态估计每一层对每个角色的敏感性，并在每个解码步骤中将每个角色分配到其最佳注入层。在两个模型、两个角色配置文件以及来自无监督和有监督提取的导引向量上，SYNC在28种角色配置中的21种表现最佳，在15种中表现显著最佳。代码可在https://github.com/yosefnuragaw/sync获取。

articles.title: ICJ-Graph: A Citation Graph and a Layered Document Corpus of the International Court of Justice
articles.abstract: We present ICJ-Graph, a machine-readable resource connecting documents of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) to cited cases, legal provisions and United Nations resolutions. Court decisions, written pleadings and oral records form distinct document layers, preserving the distinction between the Court's reasoning and the parties' submissions. The collection contains 6,396 ICJ documents and 505 documents from other courts and legal bodies, together with 12,375 provisions and 20,291 UN resolutions. The data files contain text, metadata and embeddings. The accompanying pipeline lets users load the graph and generate embeddings for use in their own retrieval systems. To illustrate the resource's use, we evaluate five models on citation prediction for 199 decisions using documents available before each decision. Tools designed for citation research improve citation-prediction F1 over answering without tools for all five models across case, provision and resolution citations.
articles.titleCn: ICJ-Graph：国际法院的引文图和分层文档语料库
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了ICJ-Graph，这是一个机器可读资源，用于将国际法院（ICJ）的文件与引用案例、法律条款和联合国决议相连接。法院判决、书面诉讼材料和口头记录形成了不同的文档层次，保留了法院推理与当事人陈述之间的区别。该集合包含6,396份ICJ文件和505份来自其他法院和法律机构的文件，以及12,375份法律条款和20,291份联合国决议。数据文件包含文本、元数据和嵌入。随附的管道允许用户加载图并为其自己的检索系统生成嵌入。为了说明该资源的用途，我们在199个判决中，使用每个判决之前的可用文件评估了五种模型在引用预测方面的表现。针对引用研究的工具，在案例、条款和决议引用方面，对于所有五种模型，均提高了引用预测的F1值，优于未使用工具的答案。

articles.title: Scalaris: A Scalable Enterprise Memory Architecture for Conversational AI Assistants
articles.abstract: Enterprise conversational systems require memory to personalize interactions, retain information across sessions, and maintain conversational coherence. At enterprise scale, however, memory must not only retrieve relevant information accurately but also provide it efficiently to the answer-generation model. Existing memory systems face a trade-off between retrieval accuracy and context efficiency. Retrieving more context can improve recall but increases inference cost and latency. We present Scalaris, a scalable enterprise memory architecture that addresses this trade-off through a unified long-term and short-term memory design. We propose that user interactions and assistant responses possess distinct characteristics and roles in a conversation: user interactions capture evolving knowledge about the user and provide value across sessions, whereas assistant responses must be stored efficiently so that only information relevant to the current query is retrieved. We therefore treat them separately and support each with specialized representations and ingestion/retrieval pipelines. Scalaris reaches 92.2 % accuracy on LongMemEval-S and 90.77 % on LoCoMo using Qwen3-32B, state-of-the-art results on both benchmarks, while supplying the answer-generation model with approximately 10 times fewer retrieved context tokens than Hindsight, a leading memory system for conversational AI. When integrated with our proprietary closed-source AI assistants, Scalaris improved overall response quality by 36 %. Together, these results establish Scalaris as a cost-effective framework for building scalable, personalized conversational AI systems.
articles.titleCn: Scalaris：面向对话式AI助手的可扩展企业级内存架构
articles.abstractCn: 企业对话系统需要记忆功能来个性化交互、跨会话保留信息以及维持对话连贯性。但在企业规模下，记忆不仅需要准确检索相关信息，还需要高效地将其提供给答案生成模型。现有记忆系统在检索准确性和上下文效率之间面临权衡。检索更多上下文可以提高召回率，但会增加推理成本和延迟。我们提出了Scalaris，一种可扩展的企业记忆架构，通过统一的长期和短期记忆设计来解决这一权衡问题。我们提出用户交互和助手回复在对话中具有不同的特征和角色：用户交互捕捉关于用户的不断变化的知识，并在跨会话中提供价值，而助手回复必须高效存储，以便仅检索与当前查询相关的信息。因此，我们将它们分开处理，并为每种类型提供专门的表示和摄取/检索管道。Scalaris在LongMemEval-S上达到92.2%的准确率，在LoCoMo上达到90.77%，这是两个基准测试的最先进结果，同时为答案生成模型提供的检索上下文标记比Hindsight（领先的对话式AI记忆系统）少约10倍。当与我们的专有闭源AI助手集成时，Scalaris将整体响应质量提高了36%。这些结果共同确立了Scalaris作为构建可扩展、个性化对话式AI系统的经济高效框架。

articles.title: They Know Where It Is, But Not What It Says: A Bilingual Hallucination Benchmark of Hadith Recall in Open LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly consulted for religious knowledge, including the recall of specific Hadith (recorded sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Unlike open-ended generation, Hadith recall is a high-stakes, verifiable task: a reference (collection, chapter, and Hadith number) has exactly one correct text, and any deviation from it constitutes a fabrication that can be mistaken for authentic scripture. This study introduces a bilingual (English/Arabic) benchmark that probes five open-weight, locally-deployable language models (Mistral-7B, Gemma3-4B, Jais-7B, ALLaM-7B, and Phi4-mini-3.8B) across all six canonical Sunni Hadith collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Da'ud, Jami' al-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah), sampling 500 Hadith per collection (3,000 per model per language, 30,000 responses total). Each model is given only the bibliographic reference and asked to reproduce the exact Hadith text, with no retrieval augmentation, and is scored on lexical fidelity (BLEU) and semantic fidelity (multilingual cosine similarity), with refusals flagged separately. Across all five models and both languages, 0% of 30,000 responses achieve both high lexical and high semantic fidelity, i.e., an exact, verifiable match to the source text. Arabic responses fare uniformly worse than English. These findings suggest that current open-weight LLMs, used without retrieval grounding, are unreliable and potentially dangerous sources for exact religious-text recall, and that deployment for Islamic scholarship should mandate retrieval-augmented generation over a verified corpus rather than parametric memory. The complete code, prompts, evaluation pipeline, and scored outputs are publicly available at https://github.com/dayam8696/Hadith-Hallucination-Benchmark.
articles.titleCn: 他们知道它在哪，但不知道它说了什么：一个关于开放式LLM中圣训记忆的双语幻觉基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于查询宗教知识，包括回忆特定的圣训（记录先知穆罕默德，愿他安息的言行）。与开放式生成不同，圣训回忆是一项高风险、可验证的任务：一个参考（包括文献集、章节和圣训编号）只有一个正确的文本，任何偏离该文本的行为都构成伪造，可能被误认为是真实经文。本研究介绍了一个双语（英语/阿拉伯语）基准，测试了五种开放权重、本地部署的语言模型（Mistral-7B、Gemma3-4B、Jais-7B、ALLaM-7B和Phi4-mini-3.8B）在所有六种逊尼派圣训文献集（布哈里圣训实录、穆斯林圣训实录、阿比·达乌德圣训集、特米基圣训集、纳斯尔圣训集、伊本·马贾圣训集）中的表现，每个文献集随机抽取500条圣训（每个模型每种语言3000条，总共30000条回应）。每个模型只被提供书目参考，要求复述确切的圣训文本，不接受检索增强，并根据词汇保真度（BLEU）和语义保真度（多语言余弦相似度）进行评分，拒绝行为单独标记。在所有五种模型和两种语言中，30000条回应中没有任何一条同时达到高词汇和高语义保真度，即与源文本完全、可验证匹配。阿拉伯语回应的表现普遍劣于英语。这些发现表明，当前开放权重的LLM在没有检索基础的情况下，对于精确宗教文本回忆是不可靠且可能危险的来源，因此在进行伊斯兰学术研究时，应要求在经过验证的语料库上进行检索增强生成，而不是依赖参数记忆。完整的代码、提示、评估流程和评分输出可在https://github.com/dayam8696/Hadith-Hallucination-Benchmark公开获取。

articles.title: From Language to Country to Valence: A Multilingual Audit of Stereotype Bias Across LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for education, recruitment, workplace decision support, and other consequential applications, making pre-deployment social-bias detection essential. Yet major benchmarks are English-centred or translated, focus mainly on negative stereotypes, and may miss linguistic and cultural variation. We investigate gender, racial, and religious bias using 12,000 locally written Reddit posts in English, Spanish, French, and German. Only search terms are translated, preserving local context. The dataset is balanced by language and category; English gender is additionally balanced by stereotype valence. Three open-weight and three proprietary API-based models are evaluated with a two-blank design that reduces grammatical-gender cues. Religion has the highest absolute choice imbalance in every model-language condition. Spanish is highest for gender, whereas German is highest for race and religion. The evaluated API models score below the open-weight models throughout. Negative English-gender items exceed positive items; Australian and Mexican contexts exceed their Canadian and Spanish counterparts. These descriptive differences measure choice concentration, not stereotype endorsement or causal country effects. The crossed patterns show how aggregate scores can conceal category- and context-specific behaviour, motivating closer inspection before deployment.

articles.titleCn: 从语言到国家再到效价：对大型语言模型中刻板印象偏见的多语言审计
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在教育、招聘、职场决策支持及其他重大应用领域正日益受到关注，这使得部署前的社会偏见检测变得至关重要。然而，现有的主要基准测试以英语为中心或仅翻译成其他语言，主要关注负面刻板印象，且可能忽略语言和文化差异。我们通过分析12,000篇在当地用英语、西班牙语、法语和德语书写的Reddit帖子，研究了性别、种族和宗教偏见。研究中仅翻译了搜索术语，以保留本地语境。该数据集在语言和类别上实现了平衡；英语性别数据额外按刻板印象效价进行了平衡。我们使用包含两个空白格的设计评估了三种开放权重模型和三种基于专有API的模型，该设计减少了语法性别的线索。在所有模型-语言条件下，宗教都表现出最高的绝对选择不平衡。性别方面西班牙语最高，而种族和宗教方面德语最高。评估的API模型在整个过程中得分均低于开放权重模型。英语性别负面项目数量超过正面项目；澳大利亚和墨西哥语境下的项目数量超过加拿大和西班牙语境下的项目。这些描述性差异衡量的是选择集中度，而非刻板印象认同或因果国家效应。交叉模式表明，总体得分可能掩盖特定类别和语境下的行为特征，因此在部署前需要更仔细的审查。

articles.title: SMILE: A Structured Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning for Liver Ultrasound Understanding
articles.abstract: Automated liver ultrasound report generation improves the diagnosis of liver diseases by producing clinically structured descriptions of anatomical and disease-related findings. However, current generative vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on a single reasoning pathway that maps ultrasound appearance directly to textual descriptions. In addition to the inherent vision-language modality gap, this design is limited for liver ultrasound because disease interpretation is constrained by subtle visual evidence, heterogeneous disease patterns, and limited paired supervision. To address these limitations, we propose SMILE, a Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning framework that uses multiple complementary specialist agents to interpret ultrasound images and consolidates their outputs through a judge-guided consensus mechanism. Our approach employs three specialized agents: an image interpretation agent for morphological descriptions, a clinical-stage reasoning agent, and a visual question answering (VQA) agent for targeted queries. These agent responses are then aggregated and scrutinized by a judge VLM using a consensus filtering prompt to produce a unified, clinically coherent output. Across a public liver ultrasound dataset and an internal clinical dataset, SMILE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs, achieving up to 19.0\% improvement in ROUGE-1 and 18.8\% improvement in clinical F1-score, while reaching VQA F1-scores of 0.82 and 0.65 on public and internal datasets, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of SMILE for data-scarce and limited-supervision clinical settings. Our models, datasets, and code are available \href{https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE}{here}.

articles.titleCn: SMILE：一种结构化多智能体临床推理方法，用于肝脏超声理解
articles.abstractCn: 自动化肝脏超声报告生成通过提供解剖结构和疾病相关发现的临床结构化描述，提高了肝脏疾病的诊断。然而，当前的生成式视觉语言模型（VLMs）通常依赖于单一推理路径，将超声图像直接映射到文本描述。除了固有的视觉-语言模态差距外，这种设计在肝脏超声领域受到限制，因为疾病解读受限于微妙的视觉证据、异质性疾病模式以及有限的配对监督。为解决这些限制，我们提出了SMILE，一个结构化的多智能体临床推理框架，该框架使用多个互补的专业智能体来解读超声图像，并通过裁判引导的共识机制整合其输出。我们的方法采用三个专业智能体：用于形态描述的图像解读智能体、临床阶段推理智能体和用于目标查询的视觉问答（VQA）智能体。这些智能体的响应随后被裁判VLM使用共识过滤提示进行汇总和审查，以生成统一、临床连贯的输出。在公开的肝脏超声数据集和内部临床数据集上，SMILE始终优于最先进的VLMs，在ROUGE-1上实现了高达19.0%的提升，在临床F1分数上实现了18.8%的提升，同时在公开数据集和内部数据集上分别达到了0.82和0.65的VQA F1分数。这些结果表明SMILE在数据稀缺和有限监督的临床环境中的潜力。我们的模型、数据集和代码可在https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE获取。

articles.title: Re$^3$Rank: Listwise Reranking with Reasoning-Conditioned Retrieval Heads
articles.abstract: Attention-based rerankers score each candidate by the attention mass that retrieval heads route to it from the question, but the question, serving as a fixed query, carries limited information for locating relevant evidence. We propose Re$^3$Rank, a listwise reranker built on reasoning-conditioned retrieval heads (RRHeads). A generator first writes a reasoning trace over the question and the candidates, and a scorer then uses the trace tokens as the attention query of a few selected RRHeads, reading relevance as continuous scores. We present a straight-through estimator to propagate the ranking loss through the discrete trace, so that the generator and the scorer can be trained jointly for ranking. Averaged over 9 benchmarks, Re$^3$Rank outperforms 11 baseline rerankers: our 4B variant exceeds the strongest baseline by 3.11 NDCG@10 points on average, and even our 0.6B variant surpasses rerankers with up to 32B parameters.
articles.titleCn: Re$^3$Rank：基于推理条件检索头的列表式重排序
articles.abstractCn: 注意力重排序器通过检索头从问题中路由到每个候选的注意力质量来为其打分，但问题作为固定的查询，对于定位相关证据所包含的信息有限。我们提出了Re$^3$Rank，一种基于推理条件检索头（RRHeads）的列表式重排序器。一个生成器首先在问题和候选之间编写推理轨迹，然后一个评分器使用轨迹标记作为少数选定RRHeads的注意力查询，将相关性读作连续分数。我们提出了一种直通估计器，以将排名损失通过离散轨迹进行传播，从而使得生成器和评分器可以联合进行排名训练。在9个基准测试上的平均结果，Re$^3$Rank优于11个基线重排序器：我们的4B版本平均比最强的基线高出3.11 NDCG@10分，甚至我们的0.6B版本也超过了参数量高达32B的重排序器。

articles.title: FindLink: Learning to Assess Scientific Connections from Source-Grounded Premises
articles.abstract: Scientific discovery from the literature requires assessing connections among findings obtained under different study conditions. Source attribution makes individual findings traceable, but does not determine what they jointly support. We introduce GI-TraceBench, a benchmark of 10,282 questions in gastrointestinal oncology that unifies provenance question answering, knowledge discovery, and hypothesis evaluation through shared Paper, Claim, and Evidence Span records. We further propose FindLink, a two-stage framework for provenance-grounded scientific reasoning. Premise Grounding constructs source-bound premises with explicit study context and support status. Structured Reasoning organizes these premises into support plans that represent both supported relations and unresolved conditions, then generates evidence-conditioned answers using deterministic compiler feedback. The compiler verifies structural and source-binding consistency, but does not assess scientific entailment. On the 1,545-question fixed-evidence test set, FindLink improves the balanced family macro score from 67.95 to 87.25 over direct supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone. A retrained variant without Structured Reasoning achieves slightly higher premise-identifier F1, but substantially lower relation and evidence-sufficiency F1. These results indicate that scientific reasoning requires not only identifying grounded premises, but also assessing what connections those premises support.
articles.titleCn: FindLink：从源头锚定的前提中学习评估科学联系
articles.abstractCn: 从文献中进行科学发现需要评估在不同研究条件下获得的结果之间的联系。来源归因使单个发现可追溯，但并不能决定它们共同支持的内容。我们介绍了GI-TraceBench，这是一个包含10,282个问题的胃肠道肿瘤学基准，它通过共享的论文、声明和证据跨度记录统一了来源问题回答、知识发现和假设评估。我们进一步提出了FindLink，这是一个基于来源的科学推理两阶段框架。前提 grounding 构建具有明确研究背景和支持状态的来源绑定前提。结构化推理将这些前提组织成支持计划，这些计划既表示支持关系，也表示未解决的问题条件，然后使用确定性编译器反馈生成证据条件答案。编译器验证结构和来源绑定的连贯性，但不评估科学蕴涵。在1,545个固定证据测试集上，FindLink将相同主干直接监督微调的平衡家族宏观分数从67.95提高到87.25。一个没有结构化推理的重训练变体在前提标识器F1上略高，但在关系和证据充分性F1上显著较低。这些结果表明，科学推理不仅需要识别 grounding 前提，还需要评估这些前提支持的联系。

articles.title: PixelBench: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Images Pixel by Pixel?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate visual assets through text-based formats such as SVG and CAD, but these symbolic representations describe images using high-level primitives rather than explicit raster values. We ask whether LLMs can instead generate pixel images directly through their existing vocabulary, without a learned image tokenizer or decoder. We introduce PixelBench, a benchmark for text-to-pixel (T2P) and image-to-pixel (I2P) generation across multiple resolutions, together with a complementary pixel-understanding evaluation. Models generate an RGB color palette followed by a grid of indices specifying the palette color of each output pixel. In T2P, the strongest models produce recognizable images directly from text. In I2P, the strongest models outperform palette-matched downsampling and specialized pixelization algorithms at low resolutions. Pixel-understanding performance correlates strongly with generation performance. A resolution-scaling study shows that pixel-generation performance often improves initially before declining at high resolutions. Finally, we introduce Pixel Reconstruction Tuning (PRT), which augments visual instruction tuning with caption-palette-grid trajectories. We post-train Molmo2-4B from its pretraining checkpoint by mixing general instruction data with our curated PRT data, improving performance across 16 visual-centric benchmarks, indicating that explicit pixel reconstruction can provide useful auxiliary supervision.

articles.titleCn: PixelBench：大型语言模型能否逐像素理解和生成图像？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过SVG和CAD等基于文本的格式生成视觉资产，但这些符号化表示使用高级基元来描述图像，而不是显式的光栅值。我们探究LLMs是否能够直接通过其现有词汇生成像素图像，而无需学习图像分词器或解码器。我们引入了PixelBench，这是一个用于多分辨率文本到像素（T2P）和图像到像素（I2P）生成的基准，以及一个互补的像素理解评估。模型生成一个RGB调色板，随后是一个索引网格，指定每个输出像素的调色板颜色。在T2P中，最强的模型能够直接从文本生成可识别的图像。在I2P中，最强的模型在低分辨率下优于调色板匹配的下采样和专门的像素化算法。像素理解性能与生成性能高度相关。一项分辨率缩放研究表明，像素生成性能通常在初始阶段提升，但在高分辨率时下降。最后，我们引入了像素重建微调（PRT），它通过标题调色板网格轨迹增强了视觉指令微调。我们通过将通用指令数据与我们的PRT数据混合，对Molmo2-4B从其预训练检查点进行后训练，从而在16个视觉基准测试中提升了性能，表明显式的像素重建可以提供有用的辅助监督。

articles.title: Tune the Baseline First: Most of Muon's Scaled Weight Decay Gain Is a Tuning Gap, but Its Small Real Advantage Grows With Model Size
articles.abstract: Scaled weight decay for Muon (Muon-SW) has been reported to train language models more efficiently than constant decoupled weight decay, but such comparisons usually reuse one learning-rate (LR) and weight-decay (WD) setting for both methods. We re-run the comparison under the MAI-Base-2 protocol: LR and WD are tuned jointly through their product for each method, on a source-scaled mixture-of-experts (MoE) scaling ladder (1.9M to 15M active parameters) that holds tokens per active parameter and data repetition fixed across sizes. We find: (1) Most of the gain is a tuning gap. At the shared setting Muon-SW wins by 0.035 bits per byte (BPB), a 1.52x compute saving; after both methods are tuned, the gap is 0.0026 BPB (95% CI [0.0018, 0.0034]), a 1.03x saving, so about 90% of the advantage disappears. (2) The small advantage that remains is real: at the smallest size, all four paired seeds favour Muon-SW at the tuned settings. (3) That advantage grows with model size: across an 8x range of active parameters, the tuned gap rises from 0.0036 to 0.0051 BPB while the untuned gap shrinks from 0.035 to 0.024, so the surviving share rises from about 10% to 21%. (4) The best weight decay moves with scale: the optimal LRWD product grows for both methods, faster for Muon-SW (ratio 1.40 to 1.91), and a law fitted on the two smallest sizes overshoots the third by 1.3-1.5x, costing up to 0.002 BPB. The whole study runs on one NVIDIA T4 GPU; we release the code and all run results.
articles.titleCn: 先调整基线：大部分Muon的可扩展权重衰减增益是调优差距，但其微小的真实优势随模型规模增长。
articles.abstractCn: 针对Muon（Muon-SW）的缩放权重衰减已被报道比恒定的解耦权重衰减更有效地训练语言模型，但此类比较通常对两种方法使用相同的学习率（LR）和权重衰减（WD）设置。我们在MAI-Base-2协议下重新进行了比较：每种方法的LR和WD通过它们的乘积联合调整，在一个源缩放专家混合（MoE）缩放阶梯（1.9M到15M个活跃参数）上进行，该阶梯在所有尺寸上保持每个活跃参数的token数和数据重复固定。我们发现：(1) 大部分增益是调优差距。在共享设置下，Muon-SW领先0.035比特每字节（BPB），计算节省1.52倍；在两种方法都调优后，差距缩小到0.0026 BPB（95% CI [0.0018, 0.0034]），节省1.03倍，因此约90%的优势消失。(2) 剩余的微小优势是真实的：在最小尺寸下，所有四组配对种子在调优设置下都支持Muon-SW。(3) 该优势随模型规模增长：在8倍的活跃参数范围内，调优差距从0.0036增加到0.0051 BPB，而未调优差距从0.035缩小到0.024，因此剩余份额从约10%增加到21%。(4) 最佳权重衰减随规模变化：两种方法的最佳LRWD乘积都在增长，Muon-SW增长更快（比率从1.40到1.91），在两个最小尺寸上拟合的规律超出了第三个尺寸1.3-1.5倍，代价高达0.002 BPB。整个研究在一个NVIDIA T4 GPU上运行；我们发布了代码和所有运行结果。

articles.title: Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities
articles.abstract: Programs that use a language model as a classifier act on its most probable label. Text injected into the input can move that label to one the attacker chooses, a hijack. A monitor that does not know the attacker's label can read the model's own confidence and raise an alarm when the top probability is low. We test this monitor on AG News topic classification with five systems, three of them served through a provider's API. Pooled over five families of injected text, low confidence ranks hijacked answers above clean ones on four of the five systems (AUROC 0.86-0.90). Ranking them does not stop many of them. A threshold set so that at most 5% of clean answers to separate calibration articles alarm falls among the least confident clean answers, and every more confident hijack passes. In our main gate run on the three API-served systems, the monitor misses 51-70% of the hijacks caused by a plain injected note (per-system point estimates). When the note adds one handwritten sentence that calls the target certain and asks for full probability, the monitor misses 99-100% of the hijacks, although low confidence still ranks them at AUROC 0.70-0.79. Confidence monitors should be tested at their operating alarm rate, against attackers who claim certainty.
articles.titleCn: 排名但未停止：检测键入决策模型输出概率中的提示注入劫持
articles.abstractCn: 使用语言模型作为分类器的程序会基于其最可能的标签进行操作。输入中注入的文本可以将该标签改为攻击者选择的标签，这是一种劫持。如果监控器不知道攻击者的标签，它可以读取模型的置信度，并在最高概率较低时发出警报。我们在AG News主题分类任务上使用五个系统测试了这种监控器，其中三个系统通过提供者的API提供服务。在五个注入文本家族中，低置信度在四个系统（AUROC 0.86-0.90）上将劫持的答案排在干净答案之上。将它们排序并不能阻止许多劫持。设置一个阈值，使得最多5%的干净答案在单独校准文章中属于最低置信度的干净答案，而每个更自信的劫持都会通过。在我们对三个通过API提供服务的系统的主要门控运行中，监控器会错过51-70%由简单注入笔记引起的劫持（按系统点估计）。当笔记增加一句手写句子，声称目标确定并要求完整概率时，监控器会错过99-100%的劫持，尽管低置信度仍然将它们排在AUROC 0.70-0.79。置信度监控器应在其运行报警率下，针对声称确定性的攻击者进行测试。

articles.title: Same Sentence, Different Construct: Identity-Swapped Rationales Reveal Measurement Non-Invariance in LLM Hate Speech Classifiers
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as measurement instruments for socially consequential constructs such as hate speech, and are typically validated by their aggregate agreement with human labels. A valid instrument must also apply the same construct to every group it measures. We test this requirement using 421 \hc{} templates that are instantiated identically for seven protected groups, so that only the identity term varies. Four LLM classifiers each exceed 0.95 balanced accuracy, yet within identical templates two of them miss hateful statements about women at markedly higher rates than the same statements about other groups (excess false-negative rates of 8.3 and 4.4 percentage points), a gap first reported for fine-tuned classifiers in 2021. We show how the construct shifts. Comparing rationales within each template, we find that models invoke protected-group status for other groups but recast the identical statement about women as personal dislike or as aimed at an individual, in 22 of 30 missed templates for one model. Adding the benchmark's own definition, which lists sex as a protected characteristic, does not close the gap, and the contrast persists. Apparent false-positive disparities, by contrast, largely vanish under identity control and trace to reclaimed slurs present only for some groups. Errors shared by all models concentrate where model and benchmark definitions diverge, and pairwise counterfactual accuracy adds little beyond endpoint accuracy. We argue that validating LLM measurement requires identity-controlled tests of measurement invariance that examine both decisions and the criteria models state for them.
articles.titleCn: 相同句子，不同构建：身份互换的推理揭示了大型语言模型仇恨言论分类器的测量非不变性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用作衡量具有社会影响的结构（如仇恨言论）的测量工具，并且通常通过其与人类标签的整体一致性来验证。一个有效的测量工具还必须将其衡量的每个群体都应用相同的概念。我们使用421个模板来测试这一要求，这些模板针对七个受保护群体进行了完全相同的实例化，因此只有身份术语会变化。四个LLM分类器每个都超过0.95的平衡准确率，但在相同的模板中，其中两个分类器在针对女性的仇恨言论上的遗漏率明显高于针对其他群体的相同言论（超额假阴性率分别为8.3和4.4个百分点），这一差距最早于2021年针对微调分类器报告。我们展示了概念的转变。通过比较每个模板中的推理，我们发现模型会为其他群体引用受保护群体的身份，但在30个被遗漏的模板中的22个中，模型将针对女性的相同言论重新定义为个人不喜欢或针对个人。添加基准本身的定义（其中将性别列为受保护特征）并没有缩小差距，这种对比仍然存在。相比之下，明显的假阳性差异在身份控制下基本消失，并追溯到仅存在于某些群体中的被重新使用的侮辱性词语。所有模型共享的错误集中在模型和基准定义存在分歧的地方，而配对反事实准确率在端点准确率之外几乎没有增加。我们认为，验证LLM测量需要身份控制的测量不变性测试，这些测试需要检查模型的决定及其为这些决定陈述的标准。

articles.title: Chain on Demand: Deferred Evidence Organization for Long-Term Conversational Memory
articles.abstract: Long-term conversational memory faces a timing mismatch: write-time summaries and graphs organize history before a future query is known, while independent retrieval can allocate a limited evidence budget to redundant or fragmented turns. We introduce Chain on Demand (CoD), a query-time evidence organization framework over an unchanged turn-level memory. Given a broad candidate pool, CoD constructs a temporary evidence chain by allocating a fixed anchor budget according to query relevance, lexical diversity relative to selected anchors, and newly covered query terms, followed by deterministic restoration of each selected anchor's same-session neighborhood. The resulting chain is used only for the current query, while the underlying conversational memory remains unchanged. In a paired comparison over all 1,986 LoCoMo questions, CoD achieves 82.2% accuracy on 1,540 non-adversarial questions and 76.3% on all 1,986 questions. On LongMemEval-S, one fixed configuration that indexes both user and assistant turns obtains 86.6% across all 500 questions. These results show that long-term memory can preserve the original conversation while deferring evidence organization until the information need is known.
articles.titleCn: 按需链式：长期对话记忆的延迟证据组织
articles.abstractCn: 长期对话记忆面临一个时间不匹配问题：写时总结和图表在已知未来查询之前组织历史记录，而独立检索则可以将有限的证据预算分配给冗余或碎片化的对话回合。我们引入按需链式组织（Chain on Demand, CoD），这是一个在未更改的回合级记忆上进行的查询时证据组织框架。在广泛的候选池中，CoD根据查询相关性、相对于选定锚点的词汇多样性以及新覆盖的查询术语分配固定的锚点预算，然后确定性地恢复每个选定锚点在相同会话中的邻近区域，进而构建一个临时证据链。生成的链仅用于当前查询，而底层的对话记忆保持不变。在所有1,986个LoCoMo问题的配对比较中，CoD在1,540个非对抗性问题上的准确率达到82.2%，在所有1,986个问题上的准确率达到76.3%。在LongMemEval-S上，一个固定配置索引用户和助手回合，在所有500个问题上的准确率达到86.6%。这些结果表明，长期记忆可以在信息需求已知之前保留原始对话，并将证据组织推迟到信息需求明确时。

articles.title: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
articles.abstract: Dialectal Arabic speech recognition remains constrained by the scarcity of dialect-resolved transcribed speech despite the abundance of web audio. We introduce GigaSpeech 3, a corpus of 39,000 hours and 10 million weakly transcribed speech segments covering Algerian, Egyptian, Iraqi, Saudi, and Syrian Arabic. Starting from 60 hours of manual transcription per dialect, we train labeling models using speech-recognition-biased self-supervised learning and apply them to dialect-matched web audio. Data selection and four rounds of noisy-student refinement for Saudi and Syrian Arabic yield the final corpus. We validate its utility through dialect-specific and multi-dialect speech recognition training and cross-domain evaluation. On GigaSpeechBench, the final dialect-specific models outperform their labeling models across all five dialects and achieve a macro-average word error rate of 23.86%, a 16.6% relative reduction from the strongest third-party system covering all five dialects, while outperforming the best third-party result on three dialects. A multi-dialect model using self-predicted dialect identities achieves a macro-average word error rate of 25.51% while also supporting Modern Standard Arabic. Across eight conditions from three external corpora, a GigaSpeech 3-trained Zipformer achieves the lowest word error rate among six evaluated models in every condition, while adapting the Qwen3 speech recognizer on GigaSpeech 3 improves performance across all eight conditions. We release the corpus and recipes as a foundation for dialect-aware Arabic speech processing.

articles.titleCn: GigaSpeech 3：基于弱标签数据扩展多方言阿拉伯语音识别
articles.abstractCn: 尽管网络音频资源丰富，但方言语音识别仍受限于方言语音转录数据的匮乏。我们介绍了GigaSpeech 3语料库，包含39,000小时和1,000万段弱转录的阿拉伯语语音，涵盖阿尔及利亚、埃及、伊拉克、沙特和叙利亚方言。从每个方言60小时的转录数据出发，我们采用语音识别偏置的自监督学习方法训练标注模型，并将其应用于匹配方言的网络音频。通过沙特和叙利亚阿拉伯语的数据筛选及四轮噪声学生优化，最终形成该语料库。我们通过方言特定和多方言语音识别训练及跨域评估验证其效用。在GigaSpeechBench测试中，最终方言特定模型在五个方言中均优于标注模型，宏观平均字错误率为23.86%，较覆盖五个方言的最强第三方系统降低了16.6%，并在三个方言上超越最佳第三方结果。使用自预测方言身份的多方言模型宏观平均字错误率为25.51%，同时支持现代标准阿拉伯语。在来自三个外部语料库的八种条件下，GigaSpeech 3训练的Zipformer在所有条件下均实现六种评估模型中的最低字错误率，而将Qwen3语音识别器在GigaSpeech 3上适配也提升了所有八种条件下的性能。我们发布该语料库及处理方案，为方言感知的阿拉伯语音处理提供基础。

articles.title: As Expected? Efficient LLM Planning via Expectation-Observation Consistency Verification
articles.abstract: LLM planning often relies on reactive executors (e.g., ReAct) that generate a single action at each step to remain grounded in the latest observations, incurring substantial inference cost. Batched executors reduce this cost by predicting multiple actions in a single model invocation, yet they are prone to compounding errors, as intermediate observations are ignored. We propose an expectation-observation consistency verification (EOCV) mechanism for batched executors, preserving grounding while improving efficiency. The mechanism generates expectations of action outcomes and compares them with the resulting observations. Consistency permits continued execution, whereas mismatches trigger early termination and replanning from the current observation. Experiments on text-based and multimodal benchmarks across multiple backbones show broadly comparable average task performance between EOCV and reactive executors, with a 29-35% reduction in average weighted token usage. Moreover, the mechanism is model-agnostic and remains effective when integrated into state-of-the-art planners.
articles.titleCn: 按预期？基于期望-观察一致性验证的高效大型语言模型规划
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型规划通常依赖反应式执行器（例如ReAct），这些执行器在每一步生成单个动作以保持与最新观察结果的一致性，但这会带来巨大的推理成本。批量执行器通过在单个模型调用中预测多个动作来降低这种成本，但它们容易累积错误，因为忽略了中间观察结果。我们为批量执行器提出了一种期望-观察一致性验证（EOCV）机制，在保持基础性的同时提高了效率。该机制生成动作结果的期望，并将其与实际观察结果进行比较。一致性允许继续执行，而不匹配则会触发早期终止并从当前观察结果重新规划。在多个骨干网络上的基于文本和多模态基准测试表明，EOCV与反应式执行器在平均任务性能方面具有广泛可比性，平均加权token使用量减少了29-35%。此外，该机制与模型无关，在集成到最先进的规划器中时仍然有效。

articles.title: Diagnosing Model--Item Interactions in Language Model Benchmarks with LSIRM
articles.abstract: Language models with similar benchmark accuracy can succeed on different items. Overall scores do not show where their performance differs or which item properties might explain those differences. We demonstrate how the latent space item response model (LSIRM) can help evaluators investigate these patterns and their consequences for model comparison. We analyze 1,348 language models on 5,761 BBH items and compare ways of presenting and scoring answers across BBH, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and MuSR. We examine LSIRM maps, which summarize differences in performance across models and items, alongside item properties and records of correct and incorrect responses. In BBH, nearby items on these maps often share the same correct answer, such as "Yes" or "No." Across the four benchmarks, this pattern is stronger when answers are scored using option labels, such as A, B, C, and D, than when using the text of the options. We then estimate each model's tendency to perform better or worse on items with particular correct answers and quantify how this tendency contributes to its score. This separates an estimated contribution associated with correct answers from the remaining differences in item performance. Two models' total numbers of correct answers differed by only 14 out of 5,761 items. Excluding the estimated answer-category contribution from their scores moved their ranks hundreds of places in opposite directions, while keeping all other estimates unchanged. The approach helps evaluators identify differences hidden by overall accuracy and understand how the choice of what to include in a score affects model rankings.
articles.titleCn: 使用LSIRM在语言模型基准中诊断模型-项目交互
articles.abstractCn: 具有相似基准准确性的语言模型在不同项目上可能取得成功。总体分数并不能揭示它们性能的差异所在，也无法说明哪些项目属性可能解释这些差异。我们展示了潜在空间项目反应模型（LSIRM）如何帮助评估者研究这些模式及其对模型比较的影响。我们分析了1,348个语言模型在5,761个BBH项目上的表现，并比较了在BBH、GPQA、MMLU-Pro和MuSR中呈现和评分答案的方式。我们考察了LSIRM映射图，这些映射图总结了模型和项目之间性能的差异，以及项目属性和正确与错误回答的记录。在BBH中，这些映射图上邻近的项目经常共享相同的正确答案，例如“是”或“否”。在四个基准测试中，当使用选项标签（如A、B、C和D）评分答案时，这种模式比使用选项文本时更为明显。然后，我们估计了每个模型在具有特定正确答案的项目上表现更好或更差的倾向，并量化了这种倾向对其分数的贡献。这分离了与正确答案相关的估计贡献，以及项目表现的其他差异。两个模型的正确答案总数仅在5,761个项目中的14个上有所不同。当我们从它们的分数中排除估计的答案类别贡献时，它们的排名在相反的方向上移动了数百个位置，同时保持所有其他估计不变。这种方法帮助评估者识别被总体准确率隐藏的差异，并理解在分数中包含哪些内容如何影响模型排名。

articles.title: InteractionBench: Measuring Timing, Task Accuracy, Whisper and Volume, and Grounding in Real-Time Voice Systems
articles.abstract: Most benchmarks for real-time voice systems focus on one aspect, such as turn-taking, instruction following, paralinguistic control, or conversational memory, each with its own data and set of systems. We present InteractionBench, a benchmark and evaluation harness that measures four dimensions on the same systems from the same recorded user audio: conversational timing, spoken-task accuracy, whisper and volume, and groundedness in conversations of more than twenty turns. The benchmark contains 221 items per system in thirteen scenarios. Before any system runs, we fix the expected floor-control actions for spoken tasks by rule and take the expected answers from scripted dialogues. We score whispering from the audio signal. We evaluate GPT-Live, GPT-Realtime, Gemini Live, Moshi, PersonaPlex, Freeze-Omni, and a turn-based cascade in 1,519 graded runs. Among the six full-duplex systems, timing and spoken-task accuracy are rank-correlated ($ρ= 0.83$), while the cascade has the highest spoken-task score (38/50) and the second-lowest timing score. No system corrects a user's grammar within the required window. Only Gemini Live whispers on most requests (8/10). Hosted systems pass 67-88% of groundedness probes, compared with 14-35% for open full-duplex models. Timing is measured where the client hears each system, so the timing of hosted systems includes network delay: for GPT-Live, whose server reports its own clock, removing a delay of about 1.5 s lowers its timing score from 86% to 56%. We also document where the protocol differs across systems, including the text instructions.
articles.titleCn: 交互基准测试：实时语音系统中计时、任务准确率、Whisper和音量以及基础评估
articles.abstractCn: 实时语音系统的多数基准测试专注于一个方面，例如轮流发言、指令遵循、副语言控制或对话记忆，每个方面都有其特定的数据和系统集。我们提出了InteractionBench，这是一个基准测试和评估工具，它使用同一系统从同一录制用户音频中测量四个维度：对话时间、口语任务准确率、耳语和音量，以及在超过二十轮对话中的对话基础性。该基准测试包含每个系统在十三种场景中的221个项目。在系统运行之前，我们通过规则固定口语任务的预期楼层控制动作，并从脚本对话中获取预期答案。我们从音频信号中评分耳语。我们评估了GPT-Live、GPT-Realtime、Gemini Live、Moshi、PersonaPlex、Freeze-Omni和一个回合式级联，共进行了1,519次分级运行。在六个全双工系统中，时间和口语任务准确率呈等级相关（$ρ= 0.83$），而级联具有最高的口语任务分数（38/50）和第二低的计时分数。没有系统在规定窗口内纠正用户的语法。只有Gemini Live在大多数请求（8/10）中耳语。托管系统通过67-88%的对话基础性测试，而开放全双工模型的通过率为14-35%。计时是在客户端听到每个系统时测量的，因此托管系统的计时包括网络延迟：对于GPT-Live，其服务器报告自己的时钟，去除约1.5秒的延迟将其计时分数从86%降至56%。我们还记录了不同系统之间协议的差异，包括文本指令。

articles.title: When Rewards Depend on the Group, GRPO Plays a Tournament
articles.abstract: Rewards for diversity, coverage and distribution matching make the reward of each sampled response depend on the rest of its group, and they are now routinely optimized with GRPO and RLOO. We prove that in this setting the group-relative baseline changes the objective. The expected update equals each response's own reward gradient plus $α$ times its effect on its groupmates' rewards, with $α=-1/(K-1)$ for groups of size $K$, so GRPO trains every response to beat its groupmates in a zero-sum tournament. It cannot see a pairwise diversity bonus when K=2, sees less than half of it at any K, and often does worse than using no baseline at all. Setting $α=+1$ gives Team-GRPO, an unbiased estimator for any group-dependent reward that works with two samples per prompt and requires no extra model calls for pairwise rewards. The theory predicts training quantitatively. It locates the fixed points of a 9B policy to within 0.02 in $\ell_1$ and predicts how concentrated trained policies become with Pearson r=0.995. On GlobalOpinionQA, GRPO collapses onto the majority answer and ends further from human opinion than the untrained model, while Team-GRPO cuts the error from $0.20$ to $0.08$. On NoveltyBench, Team-GRPO avoids the diversity collapse of GRPO and significantly improves set utility.
articles.titleCn: 当奖励取决于团队时，GRPO 会举办锦标赛
articles.abstractCn: 多样性、覆盖范围和分布匹配的奖励机制使得每个采样响应的奖励取决于其所在组的其他成员，现在这些机制通常通过全局排名优化（GRPO）和响应局部优化（RLOO）进行常规优化。我们证明在这种设置下，组内相对基线会改变目标函数。预期更新等于每个响应自身的奖励梯度加上其对其组内成员奖励的影响的$α$倍，对于大小为$K$的组，$α=-1/(K-1)$，因此GRPO训练每个响应在零和锦标赛中击败其组内成员。当$K=2$时，它无法看到成对多样性奖励，在任何$K$下看到的奖励都不到一半，并且通常比完全不使用基线表现更差。设置$α=+1$得到团队-GRPO，这是一个无偏估计器，适用于任何组依赖性奖励，每条提示使用两个样本，并且对于成对奖励不需要额外的模型调用。理论预测了训练的定量结果。它将一个9B策略的固定点在$\ell_1$范数内定位到0.02以内，并预测训练策略的集中程度（皮尔逊相关系数为0.995）。在GlobalOpinionQA上，GRPO收敛到多数答案，并且比未训练模型更远离人类观点，而团队-GRPO将误差从0.20降低到0.08。在NoveltyBench上，团队-GRPO避免了GRPO的多样性崩溃，并显著提高了集合效用。

articles.title: Solver-Like Behavior in Large Language Models as Formalizers
articles.abstract: In the LLM-as-formalizer paradigm, a large language model translates a problem into a formal program and leaves the search to a solver, gaining the solver's guarantees. Formalizers are now often reasoning models that write a long reasoning trace before the program, yet they are judged only by the program's output. We find that the trace routinely does the solver's job, assigning, testing and ruling out values until it often reaches the full answer; we call this solver-like behavior (SLB). We define an ontology of SLB over the trace, the program and its output, and use LLM judges, checked against human labels, to label 2,000 generations from three reasoning models on four constraint satisfaction datasets, each formalized in a declarative and an imperative formal language. SLB appears in 85% of traces and takes 24% of reasoning tokens, yet the program usually recomputes the answer, so the effort is redundant. The 9% of programs that inherit the trace's answer also inherit its errors, and pass output-based evaluation whenever that answer is correct. The amount of SLB is not associated with accuracy, and SLB is more common in imperative Python than in declarative Z3 or PDDL. Cautionary prompts reduce it by only a quarter, but hiding the problem's values behind placeholders, which the program receives only at run time, removes 97% of it without loss of accuracy. Formalizers should therefore be evaluated by how their programs are reached, not only by what they output.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的求解器类行为作为形式化器
articles.abstractCn: 在LLM作为形式化者的范式下，大型语言模型将问题翻译成形式化程序，并将搜索任务交给求解器，从而获得求解器的保证。如今，形式化者通常是推理模型，它们在生成程序之前会编写一条长推理轨迹，但它们的表现仅由程序的输出来评判。我们发现，轨迹通常会执行求解器的任务，通过赋值、测试和排除值，直到常常得出完整答案；我们将这种行为称为求解器类似行为（SLB）。我们定义了SLB在轨迹、程序及其输出上的本体，并使用经过人类标签验证的LLM评判者，对三个推理模型在四个约束满足数据集（每个数据集都用声明式和命令式两种形式化语言进行形式化）上的2000个生成进行标注。SLB出现在85%的轨迹中，占用了24%的推理标记，但程序通常重新计算答案，因此这种努力是冗余的。9%的程序继承了轨迹的答案，也继承了其错误，并且只要答案正确，它们就会通过基于输出的评估。SLB的量与准确性无关，并且在命令式Python中比在声明式Z3或PDDL中更为常见。谨慎提示只能减少其四分之一，但将问题的值隐藏在占位符中（程序仅在运行时接收这些值）可以消除97%的SLB，而不会损失准确性。因此，形式化者应该根据其程序是如何生成的，而不仅仅是根据其输出，来进行评估。

articles.title: EviCast: Forecasting Retrieval Gains Through Shared Response Calibration
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models with external evidence, yet relevant evidence does not ensure that a generator can use it. Indiscriminate retrieval can degrade task performance while adding retrieval and long-context inference costs. Existing methods neither determine before large-scale execution whether a generator, task distribution, and retriever configuration is worth deploying nor diagnose multiple candidate retrievers under a shared budget. We introduce EviCast, a framework that forecasts retrieval value through interventional evidence-state decomposition. EviCast measures a generator's response to controlled evidence states once and combines this shared profile with the offline evidence-state distribution of each candidate retriever, yielding the end-to-end net utility and its 95% lower confidence bound without executing every RAG configuration. A state-refinement analysis characterizes when its binary and topology-aware instantiations are exact and when shared calibration is statistically more efficient than per-retriever calibration. In frozen evaluations, EviCast correctly decides all 14 HotpotQA retrieval configurations with a forecast error of 2.75 F1 points while reducing diagnostic generation calls by 80%, and it attains the lowest forecast error among seven predictors in the low-budget regime. Its topology-aware instantiation, EviCast-T, captures the complementarity between terminal and bridge evidence, correctly deciding all 16 configurations on MuSiQue and HotpotQA and 23 of 24 after prospective transfer to a third dataset. These results show that retrieval deployment depends on both evidence availability and the generator's ability to convert evidence structure into stable net utility. Code is available at https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast.
articles.titleCn: EviCast：通过共享响应校准预测检索收益
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过外部证据扩展了大型语言模型，但相关证据并不能保证生成器能够有效利用。无差别检索会降低任务性能，同时增加检索和长上下文推理成本。现有方法既不能在大规模执行前判断生成器、任务分配和检索器配置是否值得部署，也无法在共享预算下诊断多个候选检索器。我们引入了EviCast框架，通过干预性证据状态分解来预测检索价值。EviCast通过一次测量生成器对受控证据状态的响应，并将此共享特征与每个候选检索器的离线证据状态分布相结合，从而在不执行所有RAG配置的情况下，生成端到端净效用及其95%下置信区间。状态细化分析确定了其二元和拓扑感知实例何时精确，以及何时共享校准比逐检索器校准在统计上更高效。在冻结评估中，EviCast正确决策了所有14个HotpotQA检索配置，预测误差为2.75 F1分，同时将诊断生成调用次数减少了80%，并在低预算情况下在七个预测器中实现了最低预测误差。其拓扑感知实例EviCast-T，捕捉了终端和桥梁证据之间的互补性，正确决策了MuSiQue和HotpotQA上的所有16个配置，以及迁移到第三个数据集后的23个中的24个。这些结果表明，检索部署取决于证据可用性和生成器将证据结构转化为稳定净效用的能力。代码可在https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast获取。

articles.title: Beyond Accuracy: How Quantization Affects Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Agents are increasingly used for coding tasks, but the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) limits where they can run. Quantization reduces model size, but its effects on coding agents that execute and revise programs remain underexplored. We compare BF16 with 4-bit AWQ and GPTQ for Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B, 14B, and 32B) and Devstral-Small-2507 (24B) on OJBench coding problems across three seeds. We detect no statistically significant accuracy loss for any of the coding agents. However, final accuracy can conceal substantial behavioral changes: AWQ reduces Qwen-7B one-shot solves from 17 to 0 while increasing loop-based solves from 10 to 25. All Qwen-32B successes involve tool use, whereas Devstral rarely makes a valid executor call. Failure profiles also differ: Qwen-32B produces far more compilation errors than the smaller Qwen models, rising slightly under quantization, while Devstral's failures shift significantly from runtime errors toward wrong answers and timeouts. These findings indicate that quantization robustness in coding agents should be assessed through solution trajectories, tool use, and failure modes, in addition to final accuracy.
articles.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris, France
articles.titleCn: 超越准确性：量化如何影响编码代理
articles.abstractCn: 代理在编码任务中应用日益广泛，但大型语言模型（LLM）的推理成本限制了其运行环境。量化可减小模型尺寸，但其对执行和修订代码的编码代理的影响尚未得到充分探索。我们在OJBench编码问题上，使用三种种子，对BF16、4位AWQ和GPTQ在Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B、14B和32B）以及Devstral-Small-2507（24B）上进行了比较。我们未检测到任何编码代理存在统计上显著的准确率损失。然而，最终准确率可能掩盖了显著的行為变化：AWQ将Qwen-7B的单次解决率从17降至0，同时将基于循环的解决率从10增至25。所有Qwen-32B的成功案例都涉及工具使用，而Devstral很少进行有效的执行器调用。失败模式也存在差异：Qwen-32B产生的编译错误远多于较小的Qwen模型，在量化后略有上升，而Devstral的失败模式显著地从运行时错误转变为错误答案和超时。这些发现表明，评估编码代理的量化鲁棒性应通过解决方案轨迹、工具使用和失败模式，而不仅仅是最终准确率来进行。

articles.title: VisCodeBench: a new benchmark dataset for Text-to-Vis reflecting real-world practice
articles.abstract: Generating visualisations from natural language requests (text-to-vis) enables users to explore data more efficiently. While LLMs can complete simple visualisation requests, their performance on challenging ones is not well covered by existing benchmarks. We introduce VisCodeBench, an end-to-end text-to-vis benchmark with 2,672 samples from three different domains: educational, scientific, and general audience scenarios with varying levels of complexity. We benchmark three visualisation systems---Codex, Claude Code, and LIDA---paired with a range of open and commercial LLMs across seven metrics covering execution, chart content, and visual quality. While basic execution is near-solved for strong systems, no system comes close to reproducing the reference data, with the best displayed data similarity reaching only $0.81$ and falling to $0.69$ on our hardest subset for this metric. We further find that frontier models separate on chart correctness and efficiency, with ClaudeCode-Opus-4.7 improving chart correctness by around 5 points over Codex-GPT-5 while running roughly 20 seconds faster. Separately, we find that system design matters as much as the underlying model: despite both running on GPT-5, Codex clearly outperforms LIDA, showing that the surrounding prompting, execution, and refinement pipeline can shape outcomes as much as the model itself. Finally, latency remains a practical obstacle, as even the strongest systems take 39-78 seconds to produce results. VisCodeBench is available at \href{https://github.com/SAIPLL/VisCodeBench}{https://github.com/SAIPLL/VisCodeBench} and accessed via a leaderboard; the full dataset is kept private to prevent LLM training use.
articles.titleCn: VisCodeBench：一个反映现实世界实践的文本到视觉新基准数据集
articles.abstractCn: 从自然语言请求生成可视化（文本到可视化）能够帮助用户更高效地探索数据。尽管大型语言模型可以完成简单的可视化请求，但它们在处理复杂请求时的表现尚未得到现有基准的充分评估。我们介绍了VisCodeBench，这是一个端到端的文本到可视化基准，包含来自三个不同领域的2,672个样本：教育、科学和面向普通受众的场景，且复杂程度各不相同。我们对三个可视化系统——Codex、Claude Code和LIDA——与一系列开源和商业的大型语言模型进行了评估，评估指标涵盖执行情况、图表内容和视觉质量，共七个指标。虽然强系统的基本执行已接近解决，但没有任何系统接近重现参考数据，该指标的最佳数据显示相似度仅为0.81，在最难的子集上降至0.69。我们进一步发现，前沿模型在图表正确性和效率上存在差异，ClaudeCode-Opus-4.7在图表正确性上比Codex-GPT-5提高了约5个百分点，同时运行速度大约快了20秒。此外，我们发现系统设计的重要性不亚于底层模型：尽管两者都基于GPT-5，但Codex明显优于LIDA，表明周围的提示、执行和优化流程对结果的影响与模型本身相当。最后，延迟仍然是一个实际障碍，即使是强系统也需要39-78秒才能生成结果。VisCodeBench可在https://github.com/SAIPLL/VisCodeBench获取，并通过排行榜访问；完整数据集保持私密，以防止用于大型语言模型的训练。

articles.title: Which Words a Model Fears: From a Refusal Direction to a Vocabulary-Wide Fear Lexicon
articles.abstract: Whether an aligned language model refuses depends in part on which words a prompt contains, regardless of whether those words carry the request's meaning. Harm words shift the hidden state at the generation boundary along a component shared across prompts and words, which crossed differencing extracts as a single direction. In eight models, writing along this direction raises and lowers refusal monotonically with dose, ahead of random and KL-matched directions. Used as a ruler over the full vocabulary, the direction gives every word a shift, from "feared" words at one end to "courage" words at the other; a word's shift is predictable from its own representation, and appending a feared word to a benign prompt is enough to make the model refuse it. Two held-out tests validate the ranking in all eight models: refusal after inserting an unseen word rises with its table shift, and replacing a prompt's most feared word by its most courageous meaning-preserving synonym significantly raises the answer rate on benign and harmful prompts alike, by an amount that follows the shift the replacement actually causes.
articles.titleCn: 一个模型恐惧哪些词：从拒绝方向到词汇范围的恐惧词汇表
articles.abstractCn: 一个对齐的语言模型是否拒绝，部分取决于提示中包含的词语，而不管这些词语是否承载了请求的含义。有害词语会沿着一个在提示和词语之间共享的组件在生成边界处改变隐藏状态，这个方向被交叉差分提取为单一方向。在八个模型中，沿着这个方向写作会随着剂量单调地提高和降低拒绝率，早于随机方向和KL匹配方向。作为衡量整个词汇表的标尺，这个方向给每个词语一个偏移量，从一端的“恐惧”词语到另一端的“勇气”词语；一个词语的偏移量可以从其自身的表示中预测，将一个“恐惧”词语附加到一个无害提示中就足以让模型拒绝它。两个保留测试验证了所有八个模型中的排名：插入一个未见过词语后的拒绝率随着其表偏移量上升，并且用一个最勇敢的、保留含义的同义词替换提示中最恐惧的词语，会显著提高对无害和有害提示的答案率，这个提高量遵循了替换实际引起的偏移量。

articles.title: MemShift: Separating Detection from Repair in LLM-Derived Personal Memory
articles.abstract: AI assistants store values that a language model derived from a person's records under the person's own definitions, such as their important contacts. Keeping such a value correct takes two steps: detection, noticing that an input changed, and repair, producing the correct new value. Benchmarks that score only the final answer cannot tell which step failed, and they state every change as new text. Seeing this limitation, we present MemShift, a benchmark of five shifts: source revision, deletion, redefinition, writer switch, and export. The first three fork a synthetic world into branches that differ only in the shift. Gold values and dependencies are fixed before any text, and a deterministic scorer replaces an LLM judge. For a memory that reports its invalidations, MemShift shows for each changed item whether the memory noticed the change and whether its repair was right. Moreover, we build a reference memory with known detection and repair to validate the measure. By evaluating four open-weight LLMs, we find that detection helps only as much as repair allows: the LLMs re-derive few values computed by the person's definitions correctly, and programs that the LLM writes over typed records close most of the gap to exact recomputation. Code and data are available at https://github.com/zichuanxu/memshift.
articles.titleCn: MemShift：将检测与修复分离于基于LLM的个人记忆
articles.abstractCn: AI助手存储语言模型根据个人记录生成的值，这些值按照个人的定义进行存储，例如重要联系人。保持此类值的正确性需要两个步骤：检测，即发现输入已更改，以及修复，即生成正确的新的值。仅对最终答案进行评分的基准无法判断哪个步骤失败，并且它们将所有更改都声明为新的文本。鉴于这一局限性，我们提出了MemShift，这是一个包含五个变化的基准：源修订、删除、重新定义、作者切换和导出。前三个将合成世界分支成仅在变化上不同的分支。黄金值和依赖关系在任何文本之前都是固定的，并且使用确定性评分器替代了LLM评委。对于报告其失效的记忆，MemShift会为每个更改项显示记忆是否注意到更改，以及其修复是否正确。此外，我们构建了一个具有已知检测和修复的参考记忆来验证该度量。通过评估四个开放权重LLM，我们发现检测的作用仅限于修复所能允许的程度：这些LLM很少能正确重新推导出个人定义计算出的值，并且LLM编写的程序在覆盖键入记录方面几乎弥补了与精确重新计算的差距。代码和数据可在https://github.com/zichuanxu/memshift获取。

articles.title: Does a Norwegian further-trained model give more outdated legal values than its base model? A preregistered paired comparison of Borealis 2 and Gemma 4
articles.abstract: We compare how often two released language models give outdated numeric values from Norwegian statutes and regulations: NbAiLab/borealis2-26b-a4b-preview (Borealis 2), which the National Library of Norway further trained from google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (Gemma 4), and Gemma 4 itself. The study was preregistered (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965) and uses the closed norregel benchmark, scored deterministically against a value history. On the 411 of 503 primary items where both models gave an interpretable answer, Borealis 2 alone was outdated on 10 items and Gemma 4 alone on 11 (d = -0.2 percentage points, 95% cluster bootstrap interval [-2.7, +2.5], exact one-sided McNemar p = 0.668). By the preregistered rule this is no effect of interest: the whole interval lies within the smallest effect of interest of +/-10 percentage points. Among the secondary measures, only the share of answers giving a value that took effect after the question date differs after Holm correction; Gemma 4 gave such answers more often. An exploratory comparison of two smaller Borealis models had no discordant pairs and is not informative. The design compares released models and does not isolate the effect of any part of their training.
articles.comment: Preregistered: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965. Data and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23870450, https://github.com/avalyset/norregel
articles.titleCn: 一个挪威的进一步训练模型是否比其基础模型提供了更多过时的法律价值？一项预先注册的配对比较研究，比较Borealis 2和Gemma 4
articles.abstractCn: 我们比较了两个已发布的语言模型从挪威法规中给出过时数值的频率：NbAiLab/borealis2-26b-a4b-preview（Borealis 2），这是挪威国家图书馆从google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it（Gemma 4）进一步训练的模型，以及Gemma 4本身。这项研究已预先注册（doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965），并使用封闭的norregel基准，根据历史数值进行确定性评分。在503个初始项目中，两个模型都给出了可解释答案的411个项目中，Borealis 2单独过时的有10个项目，Gemma 4单独过时的有11个（d = -0.2个百分点，95%聚类自助法区间[-2.7, +2.5]，精确单侧McNemar p = 0.668）。根据预先注册的规则，这没有值得关注的效应：整个区间都在最小的值得关注效应的±10个百分点范围内。在次要指标中，只有给出在问题日期之后生效的数值的答案比例在Holm校正后有所不同；Gemma 4更频繁地给出此类答案。对两个较小的Borealis模型的探索性比较没有不一致的配对，因此信息量不足。该设计比较的是已发布的模型，并不能分离出其训练任何部分的效应。

articles.title: When Does Adaptive Halting Win? Selection Rules Matter in Looped Language Models
articles.abstract: Looped language models can stop iterating early, and recent work shows that post-hoc readouts of the loop trajectory often rival the learned exit gate of the looped model Ouro. Such comparisons reduce each method to one operating point chosen by a selection rule. We ask whether that rule decides the outcome. On a frozen Ouro-1.4B with four loops, we compared a trained stability probe ($π_1$-x) with Ouro's native gate, adapted to a per-question stopping decision, in pre-registered studies; the confirmatory study was designed after an exploratory finding on development data and evaluated once on a sealed test set of 8,517 questions. In the pre-registered confirmatory comparison, which selected operating points with a bootstrap-screened 1 pp accuracy-loss rule, the probe saved more of the four-loop budget than the native gate (+0.053 gross macro saving over three benchmarks, 95% CI [+0.049, +0.057]), mostly from CommonsenseQA, where the probe's test upper bound on accuracy loss exceeded 1 pp. Under a point-only rule, a pre-specified secondary analysis on the same test set reversed the preference (-0.022 [-0.026, -0.018]), with operating points that exceeded the budget. In pre-specified secondary comparisons, the probe showed no demonstrated advantage over an untrained KL divergence between successive loops (+0.00125 [-0.0041, +0.0065]); we emphasise this result post hoc and claim no equivalence. The probe also broke its budget on one of two out-of-distribution benchmarks (3.26 pp loss on Social IQa). Savings are estimated from stored full-depth traces, not measured inference time, and our screen carries no formal risk-control guarantee. We conclude that halting methods should be compared as signals together with selection procedures, with strong untrained baselines and out-of-distribution checks.
articles.titleCn: 自适应停止何时获胜？在循环语言模型中，选择规则很重要
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型可以提前终止迭代，近期研究表明，对循环轨迹的后期读数往往能与循环模型的已学习退出门（Ouro）相媲美。此类比较将每种方法简化为一个由选择规则确定的操作点。我们探究该规则是否决定了最终结果。在一个冻结的 Ouro-1.4B（含四个循环）上，我们在预先注册的研究中比较了一个训练稳定的探针（$π_1$-x）与 Ouro 的原生门，后者被调整为每题的停止决策，确认性研究是在开发数据上的探索性发现后设计的，并在一个密封的 8,517 题测试集上评估一次。在预先注册的确认性比较中，该比较使用引导筛选的 1 pp 准确率损失规则选择操作点，探针比原生门节省了更多的四循环预算（在三个基准测试上净宏观节省 +0.053，95% CI [+0.049, +0.057]），主要来自 CommonsenseQA，其中探针在准确率损失上的测试上限超过 1 pp。在仅点规则下，对同一测试集的预先指定次要分析逆转了偏好（-0.022 [-0.026, -0.018]），操作点超出了预算。在预先指定的次要比较中，探针未显示出相对于连续循环间未训练的 KL 散度的优势（+0.00125 [-0.0041, +0.0065]）；我们事后强调这一结果，并声称不存在等价性。探针在两个分布外基准测试中的一个超出了预算（Social IQa 上损失 3.26 pp）。节省量基于存储的完整深度轨迹估计，而非测量推理时间，我们的筛选不提供正式的风险控制保证。我们得出结论，停止方法应与选择程序一起作为信号进行比较，并需具备强无训练基线和分布外检查。

articles.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
articles.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. On DTap, LeanGuard reduces direct prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%, and in telecom, where benign tasks need no writes, benign success is unchanged. Feedback reduces repeated blocked calls and raises task success for four of five models over a bare denial. On replayed denials, repair proves an admissible edit for 88 of 252 denials caused by argument values, in a median of 2,ms.
articles.titleCn: LEANGUARD：用于工具使用代理的精益验证护栏
articles.abstractCn: 使用工具的语言模型代理经常执行其领域策略禁止的操作。我们提出了LeanGuard，一个在工具调用到达环境之前，针对用Lean4编写的策略进行每项提议调用的运行时检查的系统。策略结合了状态谓词和作用域过去的时序算子，对执行历史进行评估，评估采用失败关闭机制，决策过程被证明等同于LeanLTL语义。被拒绝的调用可以通过两种方式纠正。通过反馈，代理会收到违反的规则和提示；通过证明引导的修复，Lean元编程会搜索一个保留用户意图的邻近调用，并证明策略允许它，而无需模型。在Tau-Bench上，使用五个Qwen模型（0.8B-27B），未受保护的代理执行了至少33次Lean策略禁止的调用，而LeanGuard一次也没有执行；通过反馈，任务成功率没有显著变化。在DTap上，LeanGuard将直接提示注入成功率从57.9%降至5.9%，在电信领域，良性任务无需写入，良性成功率保持不变。反馈减少了重复被阻止的调用，并使五个模型中的四个任务成功率高于单纯的拒绝。在重放的拒绝中，修复在由参数值引起的252次拒绝中的88次，证明了可接受的编辑，中位时间为2毫秒。

articles.title: Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents
articles.abstract: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.
articles.comment: 33 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, 3 Extended Data tables; includes Supplementary Information (12 tables, 6 figures)
articles.titleCn: 未经披露的访问：医疗人工智能代理对受保护健康信息的沉默访问
articles.abstractCn: 医疗人工智能代理在任务需要时才应检索患者标识符，这符合《健康保险流通与责任法案》（HIPAA）对受保护健康信息（PHI）最小必要标准背后的数据最小化原则。代理可以在不暴露标识符的情况下检索它们。这种无声访问对仅检查输出的评估来说仍然不可见。我们在合成患者记录中嵌入了示警鸟，并将每个工具调用与五个语言模型、四个边界级别和七个无标识符临床任务中最终答案中的示警鸟暴露联系起来。有三个模型不必要地调用了PHI工具，而Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5没有。更强的边界减少了这种访问，在最严格的政策下，残余访问仅限于用户覆盖政策或声明批准的框架中。根据任务必要性标准提供的执行前门几乎消除了这种访问。仅输出评估无法验证最小必要访问；需要结合边界、门和访问日志审计。

articles.title: A Capitulation Direction Emerges With Scale and Is Causally Load-Bearing Where Validation Is Strong: Eight Models, Two Families, and Five Measurement Hazards
articles.abstract: Sycophancy in language models is well documented as a behaviour but poorly localised as a mechanism. We ask whether capitulation under user pushback, the abandonment of a correct answer when a user objects, corresponds to a linear direction in the residual stream, and whether such a direction emerges with scale. Across eight instruction-tuned models spanning 0.5B to 14B parameters in two families, under a pre-registered protocol with leave-one-question-out cross-validation, within-question permutation nulls, and a positive control, we find no usable direction below 7B and a direction that clears our validation gate at 7B, 8B and 14B. Ablating that direction in Qwen2.5-7B reduces the rate at which the model reverses a correct answer by 4.8 percentage points, roughly a quarter in relative terms, while the identical intervention on a gate-failing direction and on a marginally passing one produces no effect. Probe quality, not statistical significance, predicts causal relevance. Behaviourally, pushback destroys three to five times more correct answers than it repairs at 1B and reaches parity by 7B, falsifying our own pre-registered prediction, and a sign-reversing crossover between pushback types survives an order of magnitude of scale in Qwen and holds at 8B in Llama, with marginalisation over five paraphrases per type. We additionally quantify five measurement hazards, including a numerical-precision effect that changes roughly one episode label in ten.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Code, data and pre-registration: https://github.com/saad-aamir/sycophancy-direction
articles.titleCn: 在规模明确且因果负荷显著时，投降方向出现，当验证性强：八个模型，两个家族，五种测量风险
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型中的谄媚行为已被充分记录为一种现象，但作为一种机制的定位却十分不足。我们探究了在用户反对下妥协的行为——即当用户提出异议时放弃正确答案——是否对应于残差流中的一个线性方向，以及这种方向是否随规模出现。在涵盖0.5B到14B参数的八种指令微调模型中，遵循预先注册的协议，采用留一问题交叉验证、问题内排列无效化以及正向对照，我们发现低于7B时没有可用方向，而在7B、8B和14B时存在通过验证门的方向。在Qwen2.5-7B模型中移除该方向，使模型反转正确答案的速率降低了4.8个百分点，约相当于相对减少四分之一，而相同干预在一个未通过验证门的方向和一个勉强通过的方向上均无效果。探测质量而非统计显著性预测因果关系。行为上，在1B时反对行为破坏了三到五倍的正确答案，到7B时达到平衡，这否定了我们预先注册的预测，并且反对类型之间的符号反转交叉在Qwen中跨越了一个数量级，在Llama中保持在8B，且对每种类型超过五个释义进行了边缘化。此外，我们量化了五种测量风险，包括一个导致大约每十个场景标签发生变化的数值精度效应。

articles.title: GRIPS: An Empirical Study of Pre-SQL Grounding Information for SQL Generation
articles.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems answer natural language questions over structured data, but can fail before SQL generation by linking question mentions to the wrong table, column, value, or relation. Even valid SQL can then return an incorrect answer. This raises a central question: What pre-SQL information helps a SQL generator, and when does additional information cease to help? We investigate this question on TempTabQA-C and BIRD. Among the audited SQL Static failures, grounding errors form the largest category on both benchmarks. We introduce GRIPS (Grounding Representation and Input Processing for SQL generation), a three-stage method that derives structured pre-SQL information to make these decisions explicit before query generation. Across GPT-5-nano and Llama-70B, GRIPS-Adaptive improves over SQL Static in 18 of 20 settings, with an average accuracy gain of 11.8 percentage points, while reducing model-call token usage by 47.8%. Our controlled analysis shows which grounding information can improve SQL generation, whereas adding more pre-SQL information does not consistently help. By separating question-input grounding from SQL generation, GRIPS makes text-to-SQL more accurate, efficient, and easier to diagnose.
articles.titleCn: GRIPS：SQL生成中预SQL grounding信息的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 文本到SQL系统用于回答关于结构化数据的自然语言问题，但在生成SQL语句之前可能会因将问题中的提及与错误的表格、列、值或关系链接而失败。即使生成的SQL语句有效，也可能返回错误答案。这提出了一个核心问题：哪些预SQL信息有助于SQL生成器，以及何时额外的信息不再有帮助？我们在TempTabQA-C和BIRD上研究了这个问题。在经过审计的SQL静态失败案例中，基础错误在两个基准测试中都构成了最大类别。我们引入了GRIPS（用于SQL生成的接地表示和输入处理），这是一种三阶段方法，用于推导结构化的预SQL信息，以便在查询生成之前明确做出这些决策。在GPT-5-nano和Llama-70B上，GRIPS-Adaptive在20个设置中的18个设置中优于SQL静态，平均准确率提高了11.8个百分点，同时将模型调用token使用量减少了47.8%。我们的控制分析表明，哪些接地信息可以提高SQL生成，而添加更多预SQL信息并不总是有帮助。通过将问题输入接地与SQL生成分离，GRIPS使文本到SQL更加准确、高效，并且更容易诊断。
